abstract: Because the number of private cars in big city increases at the annual rate of 20%-30%, so the random parking and traffic problems for lack of roadside parking space, A kind of urban roadside Stereo Garage facility would be set separately above the greenbelts, sidewalks, and bicycle lanes to utilize the midair space for roadside parking. This stereo Garage would solve the random parking and traffic problems for lack of roadside parking space. These facilities could be distributed dispersedly and managed uniformly which were operated in the operation center all around the city through GSM module. The roadside stereo garage was consisted with steel skeleton, loading board, trailing arm, motor drive system, GSM module, solar panel and emergency power supply.

articleTitle: Adaptive failure compensation control for LEO drag-free satellite with actuator failures and disturbances
abstract: Low-disturbance environment can be achieved by the drag-free satellite, which benefits the validation of relativity, detection of gravitational waves and measurement of gravity field. To ensure the safety and reliability of LEO drag-free satellite, a control scheme is to be proposed to compensate the actuator failures. In this paper, by considering uncertain nonlinear disturbances, an adaptive failure compensation control scheme is to be designed, in which failure cases of partial loss of effectiveness and struck are both taken into consideration. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Adaptive neural network decentralized stabilization for a class of uncertain nonlinear time-delay large-scale systems with expanding construction
abstract: An adaptive neural network decentralized stabilization approach is presented for a class of uncertain nonlinear time-delay large scale interconnected systems with expanding construction in this paper. So-called expending construction of large scale interconnected systems means that there are some new subsystems to be added in the original large scale system during operation. The control problem is to design the decentralized control law of the newly added subsystem on the basis of not changing the decentralized control laws of the original system, so that the new subsystems and the expanded nonlinear time-delay large scale system are all stable. In this paper, the decentralized control law and the parameter adaptive law of the new nonlinear subsystem are designed by using backstepping technique. And RBF Neural Networks are used to approximate both the nonlinear functions of the subsystems and the delay-dependent nonlinear functions in the interconnections. An adaptive NN output feedback controller is constructed. By constructing a proper Lyapunov functional, it is proved that all signals in the expanded closed-loop nonlinear large scale system is bounded. An illustrative example shows the feasibility of the presented approach.

articleTitle: Distributed control laws for multi-agent system formation tracking modeled by a wave PDE
abstract: This paper models the dynamics of a multi-agent system by a complex-valued wave partial differential equation (PDE) with boundary damping. The real part of the state of the PDE represents the position coordinates along x-axis and the imaginary part represents the position coordination along y-axis. We proposed a distributed control law for each agent to achieve formation tracking control based on the wave PDE analysis. The control laws can make all the agents to track a specified target orbit and to maintain an desired formation shape simultaneously. By applying the PDE stability analysis, we prove that the tracking error between the actual position and desired position is bounded on the condition that the acceleration of the tracking target orbit is bounded. Also, the error converges to zero, when the agent system moving with constant speed rate. The leader-enable mode is used which allows the leader agents on the boundary drive the whole system to move on the desired trajectory. By discretizing the PDE with the three-point central difference, we obtain the distributed control laws for the agents that communicate with each other on a chain-like topology. The simulation results illustrate the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Lie symmetry analysis and exact solutions to a class of new KdV-Burgers-Kuramoto type equation
abstract: Many phenomena in engineering and physics can be described by nonlinear partial differential equations. In this paper, a class of new KdV-Burgers-Kuramoto type equation is proposed. Lie symmetry analysis is performed on the equation and its travelling wave solutions equation. The exact solutions are obtained by using the power series method. The result of Lie symmetry analysis reveals that the travelling wave solutions equation accepts no global analytical non-trivial Lie symmetry, which implies the dynamical complexity of the travelling wave solutions equation. An exact solution of the class of new KdV-Burgers-Kuramoto type equation is also obtained based on balance principle.

articleTitle: The Bullwhip effect in marketing E-business system and its control strategy
abstract: The study of the problem of control the Bullwhip effect existence and quantity in network marketing system in e-business environment has built a dynamic system model with distribution centers and multi clients. The layer of clients in e-business network environment tends to produce demand fluctuation, here in consideration of the poorest demand fluctuations at the layer of clients under general conditions, taking order as a control variable the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control strategy for the Bullwhip effect existence and quantity is designed by use of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control theory. Taking the e-business network of Shanghai Baoshan Steel Co. Ltd. as an objective, an empirical study on H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control to restrain the Bullwhip effect existence and quantity has been made, as a result it is shown that the Bullwhip effect existence and quantity in network marketing system in e-business network is restrained.

articleTitle: Permanent analysis of predator-prey system with the Holling IV kind functional reaction and stage structure
abstract: The paper pays attention to a kind of non-autonomous predator-prey system related to three species with Holling IV kind functional reaction and stage structure. Based on Logistic model and Lotka-Volterra model, three-species predator model is presented. We divide the prey into childhood stage and adult stage, while supposing the two-species predators only prey the adult prey and they have no effect with each other. Then putting forward a set of conditions which confined the equation coefficient, we prove that the system we built is permanent through the four conditions. Thus we obtain the sufficient conditions of persistent existence of the three species and provide numerical simulations to analyze the system.

articleTitle: Key technology and application of digital community based on private cloud
abstract: The paper describes the technical characteristics of private cloud applying into the digital community. According to the current developing tendency of digital community around the world, it is necessary and practical of carrying out digital community based on private cloud. On the analysis of private cloud, there are many aspects applied in the digital community such as construction planning, property administration, resources visualization and temporal data management. The technology and application of private cloud will develop the construction of community, which is sure to have wide application prospects and economic values.

articleTitle: A solving strategy of connect6 based on K-in-a-row types
abstract: This paper introduces some theories of computer game-theoretical value and proposes a solving strategy of Connect6 based on K-in-a-row types. It also expounds the algorithms that made up the strategy. The strategy includes a move generator based on K-in-a-row types, a calling algorithms strategy (etc. alpha-beta pruning search and threats space search) based on the number of threats and proof-number search. Taking 7×7 Connect6 openings for example, the experimental result shows that the solving strategy is more powerful.

articleTitle: On local non-quadratic H∞ Filtering of continuous-time T-S fuzzy systems
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> Filtering for continuous-time nonlinear models in the Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) form. New method of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filter design is derived based on a relaxed approach in which both Finsler's Lemma and non-quadratic Lyapunov function are used. The well known problem of handing time-derivatives of membership function (MFs) is overcomed by reducing global goals to the estimation of region of attraction. It is shown that the derived local conditions actually lead to reasonable advantages over the quadratic approach. Moreover, conditions for the solvability of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> filter design given here are written in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) which can be efficiently solved by convex optimization techniques. Simulation example is given to demonstrate the validity of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Motion saliency detection based on Spatiotemporal Amplitude Spectrum Modulation
abstract: This paper focuses on motion saliency detection for video frames. At first, we define motion saliency as the uniqueness of spatiotemporal movement pattern, and reveal the underlying relationship between the three-dimensional amplitude spectrum and the moving object's velocity, direction and motion saliency. A modulation algorithm based on visual search asymmetry is proposed and applied in a multi-channel competitive structure to realize the quantitative measurement of motion saliency. Simulation results show that our model has better performance in detecting motion saliency, as compared with other competing models.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of impulsive differential inequalities with time delays
abstract: This paper investigates the stability of impulsive differential inequalities with time delays and proposes a new stability result. Our result is suitable for the impulsive systems with both destabilizing impulses and stabilizing impulses. We also apply the result to investigate the stability of impulsive neural networks with time delays to illustrate the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive neural network optimal control for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems
abstract: This study is concerned with the robust adaptive neural network optimal control problem for a class of nonlinear systems with parameter uncertainties and external disturbances. By using neural network (NN) to approximate the unknown nonlinear function within a suitable compact set, a novel adaptive neural network optimal controller with the adjustable parameter updated laws is designed. Furthermore, based on the Lyapunov stability theory, it is shown that the proposed robust adaptive optimal strategy can guarantee that the closed-loop system is asymptotically stable, and the performance of the design shows excellent consistency. Finally, simulation results are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed robust adaptive optimal control scheme.

articleTitle: Mechanism design and drive control of bionic robotic fish based on DEAP material
abstract: This paper investigates a kind of bionic robotic fish by using an intelligent actuation material, DEAP. Based on the electro-mechanical characteristics of DEAP, a kind of flexible joint actuator is designed. An optimal body link ratio is obtained by minimizing the errors between the fish body wave function and robot fish links. Then the kinematics and dynamic of the robot fish are analyzed. The mathematic model is adopted to represent the DEAP actuator, and an inverse compensation control is presented based on the DEAP actuator model. The simulations of PID control with the identified model for inverse compensation demonstrate the effectiveness of the design and control for the robot fish.

articleTitle: Stability and Hopf bifurcation of an n-neuron annular neural network with time-delay
abstract: It is well known that nonlinear dynamical systems with high dimensional are relatively complex to study. In this paper, the dynamics of an n-neuron annular neural network with time-delay are investigated. Through analyzing the associated characteristic equation, we obtained the local stability at the equilibrium, and then show the conditions when the proposed system lose its stability so that the Hopf bifurcation occurs. Finally, we give some numerical simulations to justify the obtained results of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: 2-D H∞ based iterative learning control design for linear discrete-time uncertain systems with multiple high order internal models
abstract: In this work we focus on the iterative learning control (ILC) design problem for linear discrete-time uncertain systems with iteration-varying factors, including reference trajectories, initial states, and exogenous disturbances. First, multiple high-order internal models (HOIMs) are given for various iteration-varying factors. Second, a new ILC scheme is constructed according to an augmented HOIM that is the aggregation of all HOIMs. Third, the HOIM-based ILC is transformed into a controller design problem of 2-D Roesser model. Fourth, the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance of 2-D Roesser model is studied under a non-zero boundary condition. Then, a HOIM-based ILC design criterion is presented to achieve perfect tracking and 2-D H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> tracking performance which yields a high-order ILC (HO-ILC). Utilizing information provided by multiple HOIMs, it is shown that HO-ILC laws outperform low-order ILC (LO-ILC) laws in presence of iteration-varying factors. In addition, a composite HOIM-based law is proposed to improve the initial phase tracking performance. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the efficiency of the proposed HOIM-based ILC design method.

articleTitle: Research on modeling and simulation of guiding Re-weighting mechanism based on guiding amount
abstract: In this paper, we propose the index re-weighting mechanism based on guiding amount in peer production community and the corresponding guiding model of producer choice behavior. In the end, the parameters of guiding model are analyzed through simulation. The results show that the guiding model could be used to describe producer's actual choice behavior in baidupedia community.

articleTitle: Consensus algorithm of multi-agents without velocity measurement in a non-rectangular bounded space
abstract: In this paper, we consider coordinated motion and cooperative control of multi-agents in a non-rectangular bounded space, and present a consensus algorithm for the agents with double-integrator dynamics. The traditional consensus algorithm for bounded space is only applied into rectangular bouncing boundaries, not suitable for non-rectangular space. Therefore, we introduce the concept of the mirrored velocity and position matrix that not only can convert the discontinuous real velocity into the continuous mirrored velocity, but also can expand a bounded space into an infinite space. The velocity-free consensus algorithm in a bounded space is proposed. Because of the fact that many previous algorithms require speed feedback, then the method of state observation is used to get the estimated velocity, and the corresponding control law is also put forward. Finally, by using the Matlab numerical simulation, the correctness of the algorithm is well verified. The velocity and position of multi-agents asymptotically converge to the same values, respectively.

articleTitle: Consensus of continuous-time linear multi-agent systems with intermittent information transmission
abstract: The consensus problem of continuous-time multi-agent systems with linear dynamics is considered. Firstly, a sampled-data consensus control protocol is proposed. Based on state transformations, the consensus problem is equivalently converted to the stability of linear time-delay systems. Next, by employing Lyapunov-Krosovskii function method and a delay processing method, a delay-dependent stability criterion is derived via 2(n - 1) LMIs. Then, according to LMIs' convex combination technique, 2(n - 1) LMIs are reduced to four ones. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Almost sure exponential stability of stochastic neural networks
abstract: This paper is concerned with the almost sure exponential stability analysis for stochastic neural network systems. Based on the methods of Lyapunov functions, some criteria for the almost sure exponential stability of these stochastic systems are derived, which show that noises can be used to stabilize unstable neural networks. Our results complete the recent works. Two examples are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Adaptive error correction for discrete-time systems with amplitude and rate saturation
abstract: We present an add-on scheme for multi-input, multi-output systems with a nominal controller in order to avoid problems caused by amplitude and rate saturation such as integrator windup and phase lag. No modelling information is needed except the number of input and output. The adaptive error correction estimates the effect of control saturation on the command following error and directly modify the command following error that is input to the nominal controller in order to prevent further saturation. A retrospective cost optimization algorithm is applied to obtain the correction on-line based on measurements of the command following error and the amount of control saturation. Different from anti-windup scheme, which compensates the control command to enlarge the convergence region, this scheme intends to adaptively contain the error inside the convergence region provided by the nominal controller. Numerical examples show that, together with fixed-gain proportional-integral type controller, the adaptive error correction scheme can prevent integrator windup and phase lag for asymptotically stable plant and critically stable plant in the presence of amplitude and rate saturation.

articleTitle: PI-PD controller design for unstable processes with time delay
abstract: A new method for PI-PD controller tuning based on direct synthesis for integrating and unstable processes with time delay. Guidelines are provided for selection of the desired closed loop transfer function in the direct synthesis method and adjustable parameter ω. Design for some typical unstable processes with time delay shows that the PI-PD controller can reduce the overshoot effectively and achieve good tradeoff between dynamic performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on distribution equipment condition-based maintenance using drosophila optimization algorithm
abstract: In view of the disadvantages of preventive maintenance for power distribution equipment, the power distribution equipment use state maintenance. Firstly the optimization model of preventive maintenance plan based on the minimum cost was set up, because of its disadvantage; add the reliability constraint conditions to establish the improved optimization model. Finally, the improved fruit fly optimization algorithm was use to solve the problem. Examples demonstrate the correctness of the improved model and the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Robust stability analysis of delayed genetic regulatory networks with linear fractional parametric uncertainties
abstract: In this paper, the robust stability problem is investigated for a class of delayed genetic regulatory networks (GRNs) with uncertain parameters. Here, the uncertain parameters are modeled as having a structured linear fractional parameteric uncertainties form. By choosing an appropriate Lyapunov-Krasovkii functional and combining the Jensen inequality method with the free-weighting matrix method, some sufficient conditions are proposed to guarantee the asymptotical stability of the addressed systems. Subsequently, the stability criteria are presented for the GRNs in the linear matrix inequalities (LMIs), which can be easily tested by using the standard numerical software. Finally, a numerical example is employed to show the effectiveness of the proposed stability criteria.

articleTitle: Improved passivity analysis for uncertain neural networks with time-varying delay
abstract: At the beginning of this paper, for neural network systems, the passivity of neural networks is studied. Then, the robust passivity of the uncertain neural networks with time-delay is analyzed. Based on the passive network theory, it can be obtained optimal passive results of the neural networks. The research shows that the less conservative passive condition of the neural networks can be obtained from constructing a new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and simplifying the quadratic terms of the new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional's reciprocal. Meanwhile, we obtain the passivity condition which does not require all the symmetric matrices involved in the employed quadratic Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional's matrices to be positive definite. An example shows the results in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Decentralized fault diagnosis and fault tolerant control for a class of interconnected nonlinear systems
abstract: In this paper, a novel decentralized fault diagnosis and fault tolerant control scheme is proposed for a class of interconnected nonlinear systems where each mode does not need to exchange information with other ones. The couplings' effect among subsystems is analyzed from the global system point of view and is eliminated by using the cyclic small-gain technique. A simulation example of three inverted pendulums illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Pinning synchronization of directed networks with Lorenz-type nodes and intermittent communication
abstract: This paper investigates the pinning synchronization problem for a class of directed networks with Lorenz-type nodes and periodic intermittent communication. By utilizing a combined tool from the Lyapunov stability theory and the M-matrix theory, some interesting criteria are obtained which clearly address what kinds of nodes and at least how many nodes should be chosen and pinned for synchronizing the whole network. It is theoretically shown that the global pinning synchronization of the considered network with intermittent interaction can be realized if the augmented network topology contains a directed spanning tree, the communication rate is larger than a threshold value and the coupling strength among neighboring nodes is suitably selected. A numerically example is finally given to verify the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Parallel Monte Carlo tree search in perfect information game with chance
abstract: Perfect information game with chance is a special form of perfect information game, which includes exogenous uncertainty from chance events. In this paper, we discuss the application of Monte Carlo tree search in perfect information game with chance and propose a parallel Monte Carlo tree search for perfect information game with chance.

articleTitle: Design for measuring and controlling system of synthetic test for high voltage circuit breaker based on DSP
abstract: In this paper, the basic principle of synthetic test is introduced. The method that DSP (digital signal processing) make control and signal measurement for synthetic test in the synthetic laboratory is described in detail. The frame diagrams of hardware are given and the problems of withstanding interference in high voltage test are discussed. The test results show that the system measurement results are accurate, high control precision, improve the efficiency of the synthetic test.

articleTitle: Pricing and congestion management based on improved chaos genetic algorithms
abstract: It presents an economic model for a communication network with utility-maximizing elastic users who adapt to congestion by adjusting their flows. Users are heterogeneous with respect to both the utility they attach to different levels of flow and their sensitivity to delay or other measures of congestion. It shows that allowing heterogeneity with respect to delay sensitivity introduces a fundamental non-convexity into the congestion cost functions. As a result, there are typically multiple stationary points. Hence marginal-cost pricing equates users' marginal utilities to their marginal costs may identify a local maximum or even a saddle point, rather than a global maximum. It gives an example to show that heterogeneity of users can lead to class dominance: a situation in which the system is dominated by a single user or class of users under an optimal flow allocation. However, that can be settled by choosing some proper net utility functions and making the sensitivity of the users' to delay is same.

articleTitle: Ancient building electrical fire early warning system based on JenNet wireless technology
abstract: This paper analyzes the wiring problem which exists in the ancient building electrical fire monitoring system, taking JN5148 wireless low-power embedded processor as the core, we design an ancient building electrical fire early warning system based JenNet protocol of wireless sensor network. To compose communication structure of electrical fire early warning system in this paper we add the wireless network to the RS-485 cable transmission network, make it become a part of the cable transmission, and combine the advantages of wireless transmission and cable transmission to form a mixed communication mechanism.

articleTitle: The continuous and coordinated control method of Captive Trajectory System in a Transonic Wind Tunnel
abstract: The flying trajectory simulation of store after being separated from the mother plane is a kind of advanced and difficult technique in wind tunnel test. The continuous and coordinated test based on velocity control is studied for the first time in the Captive Trajectory System (CTS) used in a domestic Transonic Wind Tunnel. In this paper, the dynamic trajectory predicting principle is introduced' and the move-and-stop control and velocity control mode are discussed. In order to improve the CTS test efficiency, two process of the continuous and coordinated control method based on velocity control are designed and realized. The Kalman filtering is also applied to process the balance signals to resolve the conflict between hardware filtering delay and accuracy requirements. The CTS tests using the continuous and coordinated control method based on velocity control in a Transonic Wind Tunnel show that the Kalman filtering is very effective' and the separation trajectories generated by velocity control fit well with the separation trajectories generated by the move-and-stop control if the initial test conditions are same. Meanwhile the wind tunnel tests achieve higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Study of a class of sampled-data ILC from the point of performance improvement and memory Capacity
abstract: This paper presents the design and application of a sampled-data iterative learning control combing feedback and feedforward learning mechanism for nonlinear systems with initial resetting error, input disturbance and output measurement noise. Firstly, a new technical result is rigorously studied to show that the tracking error will converge to a residual set if a sufficient condition is satisfied and the sampling period is small enough. The sufficient condition is guaranteed by a forgetting factor and the feedforward learning gain. Secondly, three types of sampled-data iterative learning controllers are considered from both performance improvement and memory capacity point of view based on the derived technical results. In order to demonstrate the correctness and feasibility, the proposed sampled-data iterative learning controllers are realized by a digital circuit in an FPGA chip and applied to a repetitive position tracking control of DC motor. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the three types sampled-data iterative learning controllers. Comparisons of learning performance and memory capacity are also studied extensively.

articleTitle: Research on control technology for grid-side converter of direct-drive wind power generation system
abstract: Since the wind energy causes no pollution for the environment and no damage to the ecology, as a kind of new clean energy, the wind power generation plays an important role in the sustainable development of the human society. In this paper, a kind of control method for the voltage-type three-phase PWM rectifier based on LCL filtering was proposed and PWM rectifier model of LCL filter was built. Meanwhile, the double closed-loop PI control strategy was put forward in the paper. Finally, under the environment of MATLAB/SIMULINK, the PWM rectifier simulation model was simulated, and the simulation results proved that the good dynamic and static performances were possessed by the system.

articleTitle: Analysis of a stochastic epidemic system with quarantine and perturbation
abstract: The global stability of the endemic equilibrium of the epidemic system introduced by Herbert is investigated firstly. Subsequently, we consider the stochastic system by adding the perturbations. The perturbations play an important role in changing the properties of the epidemic system. We get the conclusions that the strong noises can make disease go extinct, and the stationary distribution will exists when conditions in Theorem 7 in this paper hold. Numerical simulations are carried out to confirm the analytical results.

articleTitle: Gene selection for cancer classification using improved group lasso
abstract: An improved group lasso is proposed for simultaneous cancer classification and gene selection. A new criterion is firstly proposed to evaluate the individual gene importance by using the conditional mutual information. Then the weights with biological explanation are constructed and the improved group lasso is presented. A blockwise descent algorithm for solving the proposed model is also developed. The experimental results on lung cancer and prostate cancer data sets demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively perform classification and gene selection.

articleTitle: Anti-consensus of dynamic LTI multi-agent systems
abstract: In this paper, all categories of anti-consensus of LTI multi-agent systems and the necessary and sufficient conditions of each anti-consensus are acquired based on the consensus criterion of high order LTI multi-agent systems. Meanwhile, the representative and clear state trajectories of each anti-consensus are presented. This work lays a solid theoretical foundation for researching anti-consensus of multi-agent systems in depth and its application in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Nonlinear vertical plan motion feedback stabilization of a fast ferry with flaps and T-Foil
abstract: Ships are subjected to many disturbance forces, restoring ones and wave excitations causing degradations in the vertical motions which limit the development of high speed ferries. The ships safety as well as the passengers comfort are greatly affected by the vertical acceleration and several concerns arise when experiencing slamming motion and planing at high speed. This work deals with the use of two moving flaps below the transom, and a moving T-foil near the bow to counteract the effect of vertical forces on pitch and heave motions stability. A new approach of control law design has been adopted by developing a suitable control oriented model taking into account the system characteristics and the nonlinearities of the ship's excitation force. In order to achieve asymptotic stability of the ship, a nonlinear controller based on the feedback linearization method was designed. First, a nonlinear dynamic model was constructed describing the ship motion as a multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system in the motion equation. A full-state transformation was then, using differential geometry, applied leading to a linear decoupled system on which a MIMO state feedback control is designed to stabilize the vertical plan motions around its equilibrium point, thus avoiding proposing and improving the passengers comfort at high speed. The results showed that the feedback linearization controller can effectively stabilize the vertical-plane of the fast ferry in head sea using these controllable submerged devises. As a consequence porpoising is alleviated and passengers comfort is enhanced.

articleTitle: Blind sequence detection of QAM system with short received data based on Echo State Networks
abstract: A new blind sequence detection (BSD) approach using Echo State Network (ESN) is presented, together with the detailed theoretical derivation of the algorithm. The proposed method can be applied to those cases that the constellation of source signal is dense (e.g., 64QAM) and guarantees a convergence within a short data packet. Firstly, a ESN, in which the reservoir weight matrix is devised via QR decomposition from the view of receiving signal subspace which is different from the mechanism of generating those existed ESN weight matrices randomly, is constructed to solve the special issues of BSD. Simulation results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the new approach, and some special simulation phenomena of this algorithm are shown.

articleTitle: Synthesis of robust MPC with randomly occurring input saturation
abstract: In this paper, considering the randomly occurring input saturation, a robust model predictive control (MPC) algorithm is proposed for uncertain time-delayed systems. The randomly occurring input saturation and state delays resulted from the limitation of the communication bandwidth are put forward to better reflect the reality of system condition under the networked environment. A sate feedback law is designed at time instant to ensure the robust stability of the closed-loop system with respect to model uncertainties. The MPC controller is solved by optimizing a linear matrix inequality (LMI) problem. An example is applied to illustrate the efficiency and validity of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: A self-adaptive integrated particle swarm optimization
abstract: The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is a new and efficient intelligent search algorithm. However, most of the existing improved PSO algorithm in the late search efficiency is low, and easy fall into local minima, In view of this situation, a kind of new strategy of inertia weight adaptive changes been proposed in this paper, which enable the algorithm in the interim iterations can quick access into the local search, conductive to facilitate the search for the best value. And in order to prevent the algorithm from falling into local extreme value, we joined the disturbance factor and the improved acceleration factor. Using five kinds of classic test functions for performance test of the improved algorithm, the test results indicate that the improved algorithm can get better value and can avoid falling into local minimum too early.

articleTitle: Robust quadratic stability and stabilizability of uncertain linear discrete-time stochastic systems with state delay
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the robust quadratic stability and stabilization of linear discrete time stochastic systems with state delay and uncertain parameters. By means of the linear matrix inequality (LMI) method, a sufficient condition is respectively obtained for the stability and stabilizability of the considered system. Moreover, an example with simulations is given to verify the effectiveness of our theoretical results.

articleTitle: Dynamic revised mean-variance policy in a market without riskless asset
abstract: Due to the nonseparable variance term, the dynamic mean-variance portfolio selection in market without riskless asset is not time consistent or time consistent in efficiency. Similar to the market with riskless asset, the investor can perform as good as the truncated global optimal mean-variance policy with revised lower funding level. Thus, we propose a dynamic revised mean-variance policy, which is better than the global optimal policy.

articleTitle: A neural network compound control algorithm for complex nonlinear electric gas pressure regulating system
abstract: The motor-driven gas pressure regulating control technology has become the main trend of gas pressure regulating technology. In order to further improve the control accuracy, response speed, and dynamic tracking performance of the motor-driven gas pressure regulator, this paper has proposed a RBF-PID compound control algorithm for electric gas pressure regulation. Firstly, the motor-driven gas pressure regulating control system model is determined based on the actual physical model of motor-driven regulating valve. Then, the control algorithm self-adaptively tunes PID parameters online through RBF network identification. Finally, PSO algorithm with adaptive genetic operator is introduced into the optimized RBF neural network, which can realize optimized control of the motor-driven gas pressure regulating. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that the algorithm effectively improves motor-driven gas regulator's control accuracy, response speed, and dynamic tracking performance in comparison to other relevant control algorithms. It is shown that the proposed method has provided a new solution for development of motor-driven gas pressure regulating technology.

articleTitle: Noise propagation and equilibrium multiplicity
abstract: We present a noise propagation model in which clever informed traders have access to sentiment information to examine how traders' sentiment influences the equilibrium properties. In the model, noise propagation has a self-fulfilling effect, such effect generates two probable equilibria (LIE and HIE). It is documented that in the two equilibria clever informed traders have larger expected utility than common informed traders, which imposes extra risk on common informed traders. We also show that in the complementarity-driven LIE (substitutability-driven HIE) clever informed traders have more (less) motivation to chase noise and thus amplify (narrow) the utility difference with common informed traders.

articleTitle: New delay-dependent stability criteria for impulsive neural networks with time-varying delay
abstract: This paper is concerned with the stability analysis for a class of impulsive neural networks with time-varying delay. Some new delay-dependent stability criteria are devised by using Lyapunov-Krasovskii Functional, and the new criteria are less conservative than the existing ones without ignoring some useful terms based on linear matrix inequality(LMI) approach. Numerical examples show that the results are effectiveness and improvement over the previous ones.

articleTitle: New stabilization of stochastic delayed jumping systems realized by a partially delay-dependent controller
abstract: This paper investigates the stabilization of stochastic delayed jumping systems by exploiting a kind of partially delay-dependent controller, where both non-delay and delay states are contained but happen asynchronously. Different from the traditionally stabilizing controller only having non-delay or delay states or containing both, the asynchronous occurring of non-delay and delay terms is modeled by the Bernoulli variable. The probability distribution of such two terms are considered in the controller design process. Based on the proposed model, sufficient conditions for the existence of such controllers are presented in terms of LMIs, which are closely related to the probabilities. Finally, a numerical example is exploited to show the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Exponential dissipativity analysis and state estimation for neural networks with mixed interval time-varying delays
abstract: In this paper, the problem of delay-dependent exponential dissipative and state estimation is investigated for neural networks with mixed interval time-varying delays. By constructing appropriate Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and employing Newton-Leibniz formulation and linear matrix inequality (LMI) technique, a new condition is developed to estimate the neuron states through observed output measurements such that the error-state system is exponential dissipative. A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of our results.

articleTitle: A dynamic hysteresis model based on modified Extreme Learning Machine
abstract: A hysteresis model based on modified Extreme Learning Machine(ELM) is proposed. In this method, a dynamic hysteretic operator is developed to transform the multi-valued mapping into one-to-one mapping and extract the rate dependency of hysteresis. A novel ELM combining with Locally Linear Embedding(LLE) is proposed to approximate the above one-to-one mapping. The proposed model can simplify identification procedure. Moreover it can overcome adverse effects caused by the complete randomization of input weight in standard ELM. Finally, the experimental results are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of Kalman filter in microseismic data denoising based on identified signal model
abstract: Kalman Filter has been used for microseismic data filtering based on mechanism signal model. However, the model was built with many assumptions and simplifications, which did not fully represent the characteristics of microseismic signals and affected the effect of Kalman filtering. In order to establish a more accurate mathematical model of microseismic signals and improve the effect of Kalman filtering, this paper builds an ARMA model for a typical microseismic event by identification methods. The simulation of the theoretical model and the synthetic signals shows that the identification method and model are accurate. Through the processing and analysis with the synthetic signals and the practical ground monitoring data of microseismic, the Gaussian white noise added in the microseismic signals is suppressed and the SNR is improved significantly by Kalman filtering based on identification model, which verifies the feasibility of the identification model and the filtering algorithm.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of all-dimensional planar motion positioning system based on multi-sensor
abstract: With the widespread promotion of all-dimensional planar motion system, increasingly importance has been attached to the corresponding modules. This article introduces a kind of integrated module designed for positioning the planar motion system. The system contains two sensors, they're magnetic encoder and mems gyro chip. Magnetic encoder is used to record the distance of the two driven wheels while the gyro module is used to record the deflection angle. With the thought of differentiation, we decomposed continuous motion into many small pieces of linear motion to get the coordinate of the system. Another obvious merit is that the driven wheels can move up and down automatically according to the condition of the road, which made the calculation of the system's coordinate accurate.

articleTitle: Hybrid modeling method for predicting the cooling water outlet temperature in plate heat exchanger
abstract: The circulating cooling water system which ensures the production process running safely plays a very important role in the iron and steel enterprise and its energy-saving operation is based on the accurate prediction of the cooling water outlet temperature in the plate heat exchanger. A hybrid modeling method is proposed in this paper to predict the cooling water outlet temperature in the plate heat exchanger. By analyzing the operational mechanism of the heat transfer process in the plate heat exchanger, the mechanistic model is established according to the thermal transfer equation and the thermal balance equation and then the radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) is applied to develop the hybrid model with the mechanistic model, in which the RBFNN corrects the error made by the mechanistic model due to the theoretical assumption and the inaccurate value of parameter. Finally the simulation is made to verify the modeling method and the results show that the hybrid model has the better prediction performance than the mechanistic model, which lays the foundation for the operation optimization of the circulating cooling water system.

articleTitle: Least-squares temporal difference learning with eligibility traces based on regularized extreme learning machine
abstract: The task of learning the value function under a fixed policy in continuous Markov decision processes (MDPs) is considered. Although ELM has fast learning speed and can avoid tuning issues of traditional artificial neural network (ANN), the randomness of the ELM parameters would result in fluctuating performance. In this paper, a least-squares temporal difference algorithm with eligibility traces based on regularized extreme learning machine (RELM-LSTD(X)) is proposed to overcome these problems caused by ELM in Reinforcement Learning problem. The proposed algorithm combined the LSTD(X) algorithm with RELM. The RELM is used to approximate value functions. Furthermore, the eligibility trace term is introduced to increase data efficiency. In experiments, the performances of the proposed algorithm are demonstrated and compared with those of LSTD and ELM-LSTD. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve a more stable and better performance in approximating the value function under a fixed policy.

articleTitle: Robust control of T-S fuzzy hyperbolic delay model for a class of nonlinear systems with time-varying delay
abstract: In this paper, a new T-S fuzzy hyperbolic delay model is presented for stability analysis and feedback control of a class of nonlinear systems with time-varying delay. By using a new Lyapunov function, fuzzy controller is constructed and asymptotic stability conditions of closed-loop system are derived via linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Compared with the control method based on T-S fuzzy linear delay model, the control method proposed in this paper can achieve smaller control amplitude in almost same time, which can be considered as a “soft” constraint control method. Finally, a numerical example is given to validate the advantages of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the method of detecting small single-frequency cycle-slips based on EEMD-HT of BDS
abstract: For the purpose that cycle-slips could be detected and repaired to increase navigation precision, a method based on ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) was proposed to detect small single-frequency cycle-slips. First of all, a second-order different equation was solved according to observations of pseudo-range and carrier-phase. Next, the differential sequence obtained was used for detecting cycle-slips and decomposed via EEMD into several intrinsic mode functions. Furthermore, all IMF variables were transformed into local instantaneous amplitudes through Hilbert transform, while areas where cycle-slips appeared could be detected based on the point at which the amplitude was the highest. At last, the method put forward in this paper was empirically verified to be effective for detecting single-frequency carrier phases to observe cycle-slips and accurate for detecting small cycle-slips within one to five cycles.

articleTitle: A new method to judge clouds covering based on particle filter
abstract: To estimate the clouds covering in solar power tower, a new method based on particle filter tracking algorithm is proposed in this paper. When large clouds move above the heliostat field, it can be predicted by judging whether the clouds cover the sun. Firstly, a wide-angle camera is used to shoot the sky. Then, the particle filter is employed to track the sun and set up the color histograms of the sun. At last, by measuring the similarity of histograms, it can be estimated whether clouds covering occurs. Illustrated by experimental results, the method can judge clouds covering accurately.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid estimator for real-time bearings-only target tracking
abstract: This paper puts forward a novel hybrid estimator considering the real-time bearings-only target tracking problem. Bias analysis of the Pseudolinear Kalman filter is performed to guarantee the performance of its application to the bearings-only tracking problem in a recursive fashion. A prevailing Instrumental Variable Pseudolinear estimator is reviewed and a similar estimator is derived for the constant turn target motion condition. Feasibility of the hybrid estimator is analyzed and the inherent advantage of their combination for real-time tracking is pointed out. The algorithm flow is given. Simulation results verify the analytical findings.

articleTitle: Nonlinear characteristics measurement of piezoelectric ceramics actuator based on LabVIEW
abstract: Piezoelectric ceramics actuator has wide application prospects in precision positioning and measurement technology, but its nonlinear characteristics cause a lot of restrictions to their applications. To solve this problem, the experimental data are collected to establish nonlinear model of piezoelectric ceramics actuators. Firstly, the input and output data are collected with LabVIEW. And then, the characteristics is analyzed to establish the nonlinear model for the piezoelectric ceramics actuator, finally, the hysteresis characteristic description of piezoelectric ceramics is got based on the experimental data filtered.

articleTitle: A residual lifetime prediction method of cooling fan based on the operating point offset distance
abstract: As a commonly used assembly in communication cooling systems, the normal operation of a cooling fan is critical for guaranteeing system stability and reducing damage to electronic components. Firstly, the fan operating theory and the mathematic model are discussed. Then in view of the IPC9591 failure criteria, chose the fan speed and current as characteristic parameter, and then based on the offset distance of the working point, predict the fans Remaining useful life on account of the Weibull distribution function. Lastly measured data verify its performance.

articleTitle: PID control parameters optimize based on an immune fruit fly optimization algorithm
abstract: The traditional Ziegler-Nichols (Z-N) method usually fails to achieve the best control performance for tuning PID parameters. Thus, this paper proposed an immune fly fruit optimization algorithm (IFOA) with the error performance criterion of ITAE as fitness function for the PID parameters optimized. Firstly, the proposed algorithm selected the best fruit flies for immune vaccines in the osphresis search mode. Then, it introduced the immune vaccination and immune selection mechanism in the visual search mode, so as to avoid fly fruit optimization algorithm (FOA) falling into premature, and to overcome the artificial immune algorithm (AIA) shortcomings in the cumbersome and inefficient calculations. Finally, test the performance of the hybrid algorithm with four benchmarks, and apply it in PID parameters tuning. Simulation results show that the IFOA has fast convergence, good stability and higher precision, and also prove the feasibility and effectiveness in PID control parameter optimization.

articleTitle: Semiglobal distributed output regulation of switching multi-agent systems via dynamic feedback
abstract: In this paper, the semiglobal distributed output regulation problem of linear multi-agent systems subject to input saturation is considered. It concerns designing distributed linear feedback controller for multi-agent systems subject to input saturation such that the output of all agents can track (or reject) a family of reference (or disturbance) signals generated by an external system, usually called exosystem, which can be a moving target to be located, or a reference signal to be tracked, or an environmental disturbance model, etc. The interconnection topology among the agents and the agents with active leader is switching and exogenous information is not available to all the agents. A systematic distributed linear dynamic design approach is proposed for the semiglobal distributed output regulation with switching interconnection topology.

articleTitle: Adaptive tracking algorithm for a rigid spacecraft with input saturation
abstract: In this paper, the tracking problem for a rigid spacecraft with input saturation is investigated. Due to the complexity of the dynamic of a rigid spacecraft, a hierarchical control scheme, dividing the model of a rigid spacecraft into translational level and attitude level, is designed. The controllers for translational dynamic and attitude dynamic of the six-freedom-degrees spacecraft are successively proposed respectively. The input saturation is also considered in designing the two controllers. For translational level, a kind of special saturation function is employed to get the controller whose amplitude is constrained. For the attitude dynamic, a new adaptive quaternion-based control scheme is proposed to withstand the effect of bounded uncertain items and input saturation. Finally, simulation results are provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: State space description based predictive control for normal temperature continuous transonic wind tunnel
abstract: In this paper, considering the normal temperature continuous transonic wind tunnel is a typical complex system, we utilize predictive control algorithm based on its state space description to control this system. Meanwhile, optimize the error weighting coefficient matrix Q and control weighting coefficient matrix R by genetic algorithm. Through simulation experiments show that applying the control algorithm makes the wind tunnel system own the characteristic of fast response and good steady performance.

Author Keywords: Normal Temperature Continuous Transonic Wind Tunnel

articleTitle: Rough reduction algorithm for reduction of metagenomic DNA digital signature
abstract: The renewal of sequencing technology have promoted the rapid development of metagenomics, which have lead to the sharply increasing of sequenced metagenome DNA sequences number. But most of DNA sequences species are unknown and the current method is to extract nearly ten thousands digital features as the species label, and oversize feature dimension will make large amount of calculation, so how to reduce those large metagenome DNA digital features is a problem that bioinformatics faced. A rough reduction method based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is designed which take use of rough theory and combine PSO algorithm. This algorithm have been applied to reduce the metagenome DNA sequences on the level of genera which have approved that it can make effective reduction for metagenome DNA digital features and get more classification accuracy rate than before.

articleTitle: The dynamical behavior of a SEI model: Acute and chronic stagesand nonlinear incidence rate
abstract: In this paper, according to consequent system of a SEI model, a model withvital dynamical and nonlinear incidence rate of saturated mass action is proposed. By making use of differential equation and characteristic of hepatitis C, we analyze the equilibrium of the model with nonlinear incidence rate and come up with several theorems about stability.

articleTitle: Image classification via multi-view model
abstract: With the massive growth of digital image data uploaded to the Internet, classifying each image into appropriate semantic category based on the image content for image index and image retrieval has become an increasingly difficult and laborious task. To deal with this issue, we propose a novel multi-view semi-supervised learning framework which leverages the information contained in pseudo-labeled images to improve the prediction performance of image classification using multiple views of an image. In the training process, labeled images are first adopted to train view-specific classifiers independently using uncorrelated and sufficient views, and each view-specific classifier is then interactively re-trained using initial labeled samples and additional pseudo-labeled samples based on a measure of confidence. In the classification process, the maximum entropy principle is utilized to assign appropriate category label to each unlabeled image using optimally trained view-specific classifiers. Experimental results on a general-purpose image database demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed multi-view semi-supervised scheme.

articleTitle: A study of identification of wide-sense stationary in chemical processes
abstract: In the chemical production, the wide-sense stationary process is more common due to the disturbance of environment or unit. Steady state identification based on chemical process data has been the focus of researchers. However, there is no good and effective method for the automatic identification of wide-sense stationary. Firstly, we apply the improved first-order filter to remove the measurement noise, then using the double-threshold method to detect wide-sense stationary process in this paper. Finally, the validity of the method is demonstrated by simulation data and experimental data of ethanol-water distillation column (EWDC).

articleTitle: Integral input-to-state-K L∗-stability for hybrid dynamical systems
abstract: This paper aims to study the issue of integral input-to-state stability (iISS) for hybrid dynamical systems (HDS). The notions of iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θL</sub> K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θK</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>-property and iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θ</sub>-stability were proposed for HDS. The iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θL</sub> K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θK</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>-property, including input-to-state stability (iISS) and iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θ</sub>-stability, is a more general input-to-state property and reflects the specific effects on the dynamic behavior of a HDS from its continuous/discrete-time subsystems and switching events. A HDS with iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θL</sub>K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θK</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>-property may be non-iISS. The relations between iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θL</sub>K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θK</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>-property and iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θL</sub>-stability are established under some hybrid dwell time condition. Moreover, a criterion of iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θ</sub>-stability is derived by using the iIS-K L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θL</sub>K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">θK</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>-property of subsystems.

articleTitle: All parameters adaptive fractional order PI/PD type iterative learning control
abstract: In this paper, a novel strategy is applied to the design of all parameters adaptive fractional order PI/PD type iterative learning control scheme. The current result of order adaptive fractional order iterative learning control guarantees the convergence of fractional order PI/PD ones. To our best knowledge, the flat phase technique is first combined with fractional order iterative learning control schemes that improves the convergence speed for both linear fractional order systems with known structure, and black box systems with known input/output data, where the fractional order impulse response invariant discretization method is applied. A number of numerical simulations show that the designed fractional order PI/PD type iterative learning controller guarantees the fact of convergence and the convergence speed simultaneously which implies the efficiency of the above discussed concepts.

articleTitle: Terrain estimation and strategy for quadruped robot body posture and COG adjustment
abstract: Quadruped robot has gained its popularity due to the adaptation ability of rough terrain. To improve the walking stability and balance of quadrupeds, separate static walking methods are discussed based on specific known terrains. For some unknown terrains, a uniform terrain model is established in this paper. A fuzzy logic based terrain estimation method is then proposed to estimate the terrain parameters. Based on the criterion of maximum working space, a body posture and center of gravity (COG) position adjusting strategy is proposed, and a method to adjust the posture and COG position is derived based on the kinematic analysis. Simulations show that the proposed methods can deal with different terrains and body posture and COG position can be tuned according to the terrain.

articleTitle: Analysis on the interaction of employment, wages and income gap of urban residents in China
abstract: The employment, wages and income gap of urban residents in the eastern, central and western of China, were interacted and influenced mutually, how to promote their coordinated development, which has become the top priority of the current government work, but also the focus of scholars research. The number of employees at the end of the year, the total wages and the Gene coefficient of urban residents in China, were regarded as explanatory variable and explained variable in the paper. The dynamic interaction of employment, wages and income gap were measured by using the software of Eviews6.0 based on the panel data in China Statistical Yearbook from 2002 to 2012. The research results have shown the interaction of employment on improving or worsening the income gap is less than the interaction of the wages, and the interaction of employment on income gap is gradually decreasing, the interaction of wages on income gap is increasing from eastern to western in China.

articleTitle: A track initiation algorithm based on the feature weighted Denstream clustering
abstract: In order to improve the track initiation accuracy and effectiveness, we propose a track initiation algorithm based on the feature weighted Denstream clustering. The algorithm chooses the position and the amplitude as the feature vector. Before the tracking process, the weight coefficient of each feature vector is calculated using the Maximum Entropy Relief feature weighting method. The feature weight is added to the Denstream algorithm to calculate the distance between two vectors. Renyi entropy is adopted to determine whether the potential tracks are output. Simulation results show that the novel algorithm is more effectively to initialize the track in the clutter environment.

articleTitle: An object oriented dynamic security reference model for virtual enterprises
abstract: This paper aims at how to construct the security architecture for virtual enterprises. In order to help the virtual enterprise to be adaptive of these urgent security problems result from the soaring new applications based on internet, a dynamic security reference model named Object oriented PDRR model is proposed. The security requirement, access operations, security architecture and working mechanism are discussed in detailed. Based on the security reference model, an information security system, including intrusion detection and vulnerability scanning system, firewall and antivirus system, was construct for a virtue enterprise. The presented case verified the model's applicability.

articleTitle: Group decision model of internet public opinion emergency with linguistic assessment
abstract: This paper presents a multi-criteria group decision model for Internet public opinion emergency with linguistic assessments involved with multiple emergency experts based on the minimum principle of weighted deviation between each network public opinion emergency and the extreme emergency. By using the proposed emergency decision model we can easily obtain the optimal weight of each decision index and calculate the comprehensive crisis of each emergency. It can greatly aid the government to deal with all the Internet public opinion emergencies in accordance with the ranking of crisis and make the corresponding decision scheme to execute emergency operation.

articleTitle: Dynamic game analysis of R&D investment in low carbon supply chain
abstract: On the basis of the differential game theory, the paper studies low carbon R&D investment of a supply chain consisting of a single manufacturer and a single retailer, set up differential game models under the Nash and Stackelberg game, and using the theory of differential games to study the low carbon R&D investment strategy of the manufacturer and retailer.

articleTitle: Observer-based impulsive stabilization for spacecraft rendezvous
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of observer-based impulsive stabilization for spacecraft rendezvous. An observer-based control strategy is developed to solve the stabilization problem in the presences of parameter uncertainty and variance constraint. Sufficient condition for the existence of the proposed controller is provided, and the controller synthesis problems are solved via linear matrix inequalities approach. Finally, a numerical example is established to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approach.

articleTitle: A method for measuring the position of discharging billet in heating furnace based on image recognition
abstract: According to the characteristics of the noise of discharging billet, method based on scale product using wavelet transform for denoising is introduced in this thesis. Then evaluation criteria based on edge detection which evaluates the quality of image denoising is proposed, according to the requirements of captured pictures in the thesis. With the position of slab changing in image, gray of edge is changing. So it is unsuitable to detect edge by the fixed threshold value. Therefore, in order to improve image contrast between slab edge and background, image enhancement based on wavelet transform is adopted. Then, the slab edge is detected by Canny operator. After that using Hough transform extract complete and smooth edges of slab. In image, the size of slab is known. Taking advantage of reconstructed image, the relationship of pixel and actual size is assured. At last we can calculate the real position of the slab in reheating furnace.

articleTitle: Harmonic separation method based on sparse representation for power system
abstract: With the increase of power electronic devices, harmonic pollution in power system is inevitable. It is urgent to separate harmonics in order to improve the power quality. This paper presents a novel harmonic separation method in which the frequency sparsity of harmonic is fully used. First, two channel signals constructed from the original sampled data are transformed to frequency domain with Short-Time Fourier Transform. Then, the mixing matrix is estimated by clustering the points in frequency scatter diagram. Finally, the corresponding harmonic components are separated by the minimal L1 norm decomposition. The simulation results validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: An efficient backoff algorithm for QoS guaranteeing in wireless networks
abstract: Wireless networks are required to guarantee the Quality of Service (QoS), including throughput, fairness, delay, etc. IEEE802.11 MAC protocol employs a typical backoff mechanism, Binary Exponential Backoff (BEB) algorithm, to avoid collisions when multiple users try to access the shared wireless channel. Many works on QoS guaranteeing point out that the BEB algorithm introduces the unfairness and serious delay problem into channel access. To solve the problem above, this paper proposes a novel backoff algorithm, which adopts a retransmission counter to measure the network congestion situation. The proposed algorithm also divides the contention window interval into small intervals, and in different intervals, it leverages different backoff strategies. Performance of this algorithm is compared with BEB and other improved backoff algorithms through simulation. The analysis and simulation results show that the proposed backoff algorithm can provide better QoS guaranteeing in terms of throughput, fairness, and delay.

articleTitle: Fast design and optimization of the low energy lunar escaping trajectory
abstract: In this paper, a fast design and optimizing method of the low energy lunar escaping trajectory is introduced in the earth-moon elliptical four body system. Firstly, to find the optimal escaping conditions rapidly, the energy demand of the spacecraft is analyzed and it's found that when Moon is getting near its perigee and Sun becomes co-linear with Earth and Moon the escaping will consume the least amount of fuel. Then, given the appropriate launching opportunity the Manifold Degeneration Method is introduced to optimize the escaping energy. Finally, the computing process of the escaping trajectory design and optimization which contains 5 steps is given. According to the simulation results, the computing process proposed is effective in searching the optimal escaping trajectory and over 25% of the launching impulse can be saved with the optimal escaping orbit.

articleTitle: Single machine scheduling problem with cost constraints based on customer driven and its noncooperative game
abstract: This paper considers the single machine scheduling problem with cost constraints based on customer driven using noncooperative game theory. The single machine scheduling problem with cost constraints based on customer driven is introduced, and customers bidding strategy is analyzed using noncooperative game method. Then noncooperative game model of single machine scheduling with cost constraints is defined using noncooperative game theory, in which the customer is mapped to the player, customer quotation corresponds to player strategy, and a payoff function of players is defined on condition of two main customer objectives. The satisfactory result of scheduling problem can be achieved by seeking Nash equilibrium solution, and the steps of seeking Nash equilibrium solution for the proposed scheduling game model are given. A single scheduling case is analyzed and solved, and the result verifies the validity of the proposed game model and the solving method.

articleTitle: On the system environment of pension insurance for urban workers in Heilongjiang province
abstract: Along with the gradually development of the national economy, as well as the increasing aging population, now days improving the pension insurance system of urban workers has been gradually put on the agenda. In the basic social insurance, the pension insurance is the most popular, but the formation is a short time in Heilongjiang province. This paper analyzed the system environment of pension insurance for urban workers in the current surrounding, through the collection and integration of the data of the provincial pension insurance in recent years, then put forward the utilizing means such as strengthening the law, avoiding the happening of the pension insurance pay escape, and thus improved the pension insurance performance of urban workers as to provide policy proposal for the government of Heilongjiang province in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of recent secure scan test techniques
abstract: When scan test techniques are applied for cryptographic chips, side channel attack may result in user key leakage. Many secure scan designs have been proposed to protect the user key. This paper meticulously selects three current scan test techniques and analyses their advantages and disadvantages. The paper also compares them in several aspects, such as security and area overhead. User can choose one of them according to the requirements; further combination can be implemented to achieve better performance.

articleTitle: Control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on extended sliding mode state observer
abstract: In this paper, the mathematical model of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor in static two-phase coordinate frame is introduced. Based on this, the extended sliding mode observer and phase-locked loop are designed in the control system. the three-phase asynchronous motor is controlled using SVPWM control strategy. The control system is simulated by MATLAB. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme is feasible and the space vector control system has a good dynamic respond.

articleTitle: CBR-based grey relational identification method for technical risks in equipment tests
abstract: Considering that poor/limited data about technical risks is obtained in equipment tests, it's not a good idea to use existing methods to identify and deal with new risks. In this paper, a four-step method which combining case based reasoning and grey relational analysis is proposed. By utilizing prior information, a case library, in which every case is described in details representing for certain kind of technical risk, is built. With a new kind of risk symptom rising, the previous library is retrieved to find the case with largest conditional degree, and then a recommendation solution for the new risk symptom is given according to the solution which is taken to solve the risk with largest conditional degree mentioned above. The knowledge comes into being in the process of dealing with the new risk symptom, is combined into a new case, by creating or modifying the existing case. At last, the new case is stored in the case library. A practical example is provided. The results show that the CBR-based grey relational technical risk identification method is sensible and feasible.

articleTitle: A new type multifunction flashlight based on SQ680S and μ C/OS-II
abstract: For the needs of pictures, audio and video recordings of the questionable regions or events when security personnel patrol at night, a cost-effective multi-functional flashlight based on SQ680S chip was designed. SQ680S chip has high integration, stable performance. It can provide a good function and quality of multimedia processing functions. The system adopts OV5653 camera to take photos and record videos and provides a 2.4-inch TFT color screen thus to make it easier for the site operator to see the effect. The perfect power supply circuit and simple mode of operation are also designed. System software uses the μC/OS-II real-time operating system to support multi task implementation, improves the recording and playback function, and increases the utilization efficiency of storage space by improving the circulation recording technology. The application test shows that the system can stably and smoothly complete the expected function and it has high quality recording. The pictures and videos it takes are clear and with bright color, strong sense of hierarchy and high contrast. It can better meet practical application needs.

articleTitle: Base on multipath transmission business of QoE evaluation survey
abstract: In the present multipath transmission technology, lack of research on QoE evaluation mechanism, most of previous QoE evaluation mechanism applied to traditional p2p transmission, thus cannot give full play to the multipath QoE for path measurement, load distribution and congestion control management forecast monitoring function. Therefore, this paper from the current research situation and progress of QoE, through the the introduction of the reviewed by QoE quantitative and measurement method, selection of video streaming media service as the research object, using the analytic hierarchy process (ahp) to establish multipath transmission environment video business data sample training set, evaluates the centralized coordination of multipath QoE. Through the simulation experiments prove that the method can according to the change of each transmission sub-paths forecast real-time business data and the dynamic adjustment, ensure quality of end user experience.

articleTitle: LS-SVM based anti-surge predictive control of centrifugal compressor
abstract: This paper researches a kind of anti-surge control strategy for centrifugal compressor. In order to solve the problem of narrow operating range of the traditional anti-surge control, model predictive control is introduced. First ratio and mass flow nonlinear predictive models of compressor's pressure are developed by LS-SVM (Least Square Support Vector Machine). Then the anti-surge predictive controller is designed according to anti-surge conditions. Finally, simulation results prove that the predictive control is a suitable method for anti-surge control of centrifugal compressor. It shows that the surge line and the surge control line can be effectively cut down and the operation scope of centrifugal compressor can be largely widened.

articleTitle: Nonlinear time-varying fractional order system simulation based on MATLAB
abstract: With the development of computer technology, fractional order systems are widely used in fields of signal processing and control processing, fluid mechanics and so on.
