Besides the combination with hydraulic and thermal characteristics for single pipe, the method to list the balance equations and form the synthetic model of the network is proposed. Through the algorithm based on Newton-Raphson method, the static flow rates distribution in the network can be estimated in real time with the known measurements of pressure and temperature. The simulation result proves the validation of the model and the effectiveness of the algorithm. The method may be applied for the data reconciliation of pipeline network flow rates and assisting steam production scheduling in the plants.

articleTitle: Research on energy saving control of chilled water system of central air conditioning system
abstract: Traditionally, the equipment of central air-conditioning system include refrigeration circulating water system, cooling water system, cooling tower fan system, etc. The design of their capacity is based on the building's maximum cooling, heat load or fresh air. And the motor is fixed for a long time in power frequency state run at full speed, no matter how user load change. However, the user loads is low in the most time, so it caused great waste of energy. This paper research a method of Fuzzy PID on the control of frozen pump frequency control, which will change the frequency of frozen pump based on the variation of user's load and achieve the goal of energy saving.

articleTitle: Global and blow-up solutions for a class of nonlinear parabolic equations
abstract: In this paper, the global and blow-up solutions for a class of nonlinear parabolic equations under the nonlinear Neumann boundary condition is investigated. By constructing auxiliary functions and using the maximum principle, we obtain the sufficient conditions for the existence of global and blow-up solutions with some appropriate assumptions. The upper estimate of the global solution and the upper bound for “blow-up time” are also provided.

articleTitle: Frequency reformation of ground source heat pump system based on proportional control with grey prediction
abstract: Ground Source Heat Pump (GSHP) air conditioning system has been maturely applied in greenhouse temperature adjustment, which is mainly used for heating in greenhouse during the winter. Although GSHP system is a high-efficiency and energy-saving system, it still has the potential to save energy in the practical application by changing operation mode. The method of changing circulating pump's working frequency of GSHP system was proposed in the article. The greenhouse environment characteristics are a combination of great inertia, pure time-delay, nonlinear and model uncertainty which make it difficult for us to obtain an accurate mathematical model. Therefore, it is not advisable applying some traditional algorithms like PID control algorithm in the system. To solve the problem, this article introduces grey prediction method into temperature modeling process which uses previous temperature data sequence to forecast future temperature and the predicted future data as feedback value into the controller. The controller choose proportional control algorithm that uses the difference between the predicted temperature and the setting temperature to adjust the frequency of the circulating pump. In that way, the energy consumption can be reduced. To find the most proper proportional parameter, optimal control method is selected. Experimental results show that this control method not only improves the control quality of the circulating pump, but also achieves the purpose of saving energy.

articleTitle: Attitude stabilization and tracking of Quadrotors
abstract: Attitude stabilization and tracking is an important issue in the flight of the Quadrotor, especially in the windy environment. This paper focus on the attitude stabilization and tracking problem, detailed mathematical modeling was proposed and two kinds of attitude control architectures were evaluated through mathematical simulations, meanwhile the zero-mean white noise was added to the control signal, the simulation results verify the feasibility of the proposed control laws.

articleTitle: Robust stabilizing regions of fractional-order PI controllers for permanent magnet synchronous motor control system
abstract: The application of fractional order calculus in motor control systems has got much attention recently, and one of the major research is using fractional-order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controllers instead of integral-order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controllers. Moreover, there are many approaches to obtain the suitable parameters of fractional-order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controllers, commonly according to different performance indexes or amplitude and phase margin conditions. This paper presents a graphical approach to determine the stabilizing regions of fractional-order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup> controllers, for robust speed control of the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors. Based on D-decomposition method, the stabilizing regions in terms of the real root boundary(RRB) curves, complex root boundary(CRB) curves and infinite root boundary(IRB) lines are investigated for a given stability degree. Compared with the well-tuned PI controller, experiment results verify that the fractional-order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup> controller has better effects on improving robustness of system against the disturbances.

articleTitle: PSO and genetic algorithm optimization BP neural network contrast in collaboration innovation performance evaluation
abstract: Strategic emerging industries takes a leading role in the economic and social situation and long-term development. Cooperative innovation is an important start for the cultivation and development of strategic emerging industries. The performance evaluation are the means to grasp the level of the performance level of the research, and it is an important tool for the scientific analysis of the collaborative innovation. This research is based on the research object of the coordination and innovation of industry, university and research in the major provinces and cities of China. Through constructing the performance evaluation system of the industry-university-research cooperative innovation, the evaluation model of the collaborative innovation performance has been built. Studying and comparing the effect of BP neural network based on genetic algorithm and PSO in the performance evaluation. To measure the level of collaborative innovation performance objectively and find out the problems of the strategic emerging industries and the existence of the collaborative innovation in the industry, to facilitate the government to introduce the corresponding policies and methods. Research shows the Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) as two popular evolutionary algorithms both have global optimization features, they can make up the defect of Back Propagation(BP) neural network which is easily falling into minimum value. In this paper, PSO algorithm and genetic algorithm are simulated and the results are compared with each other and themselves. Compared with genetic algorithm, PSO algorithm proved it is easier to get the optimal value.

articleTitle: Competitive ability evaluation for generation enterprises based on combinational weight and improved TOPSIS
abstract: In allusion to the problems of competitive ability evaluation for generation enterprises, the improved TOPSIS method, which is based on combinational weight, is proposed. The objectivity of the entropy method and the practical rationality of the AHP is combined, through the entropy method and analytic hierarchy process method combination weighting. The vertical distance, instead of Euclidean distance evaluation, is adopted in case of the shortcomings of TOPSIS method in comprehensive evaluation. The rationality and the reliability of the proposed method are proved by combining with the concrete examples.

articleTitle: Hybrid model based fault tolerant control for quadrotor helicopter with structural damage
abstract: This paper is a follow-up work of the hybrid modelling of a quadrotor helicopter proposed by the authors. Aiming at the structure damages in quadrotor helicopters, a hybrid model based dynamical feedback FTC scheme is studied. The proof of the closed-loop system's stability is also presented. Verification results on a 3-DOF hovering system can show the effectiveness of the proposed FTC scheme.

articleTitle: Design and improvement of the parallel algorithm in the computer games system
abstract: The core technology of the computer games is the search. The paper is studied to research both the mononuclear search algorithm and the parallel search algorithm. For the mononuclear search algorithm, the selective search thought is supplied to the computer games system. For the parallel search algorithm, the paper studies the several existing multi-core parallel search methods and analyzes their advantages and disadvantages. According to the characteristics, the improvement scheme is put forward to the parallel search algorithm. The practical results of the computer games system show the comparison effect between the original methods and the improved methods. The paper finally discusses some special programming skills of the Alpha-Beta implementation in the parallel search system. The advanced and modified algorithm is proved to be practical and applicative by experimentations and tests of parallel computer games system provided in this paper.

articleTitle: A frequency domain feature based cascade classifier and its application to fault diagnosis
abstract: In this paper, a new method of frequency domain feature extraction based on real discrete Fourier transform (RDFT) is proposed. The feature dimension is greatly reduced and pretty good real-time performance is achieved. In addition, to solve the multiple signal classification problem and get a detailed result, a method which adaptively chooses signal combination with the best accuracy and a cascade classifier using adaboost for the case of insufficient signal sources are designed. Experimental results show that the proposed method is computationally efficient and can archive high diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: An abstract communication service interface of DPWS on embedded device in industrial automation
abstract: In view of the aging society, intelligent devices are more and more widely used in the field of industrial automation. The future factory will be dominated by Service-oriented Architecture (SOA). Devices can be abstracted by web services to enable their flexibility, dynamicity and interoperability with other devices. This paper presents an abstract communication service interface for web services that contributes to providing the flexible, loosely coupled system on embedded devices in an automatic industrial production line in which the implementations of the interface is constructed by the Devices Profile for Web Services (DPWS). It shows promising results in the remote data transmission without human intervention between the embedded server and enterprise information system.

articleTitle: Sufficient conditions of observer-based control for nonlinear fractional-order systems
abstract: In this article, we presents a method based on the state observer design for a class of nonlinear fractional-order systems (FOSs) with the fractional-order 0 <; α <; 1. The asymptotic stability conditions of closed-loop control nonlinear systems are derived by Fractional Lyapunov direct method. The observer gain matrix and control gain matrix are obtained in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) formulation. Finally, a numerical example of fractional-order chaotic Lorenz systems is given to demonstrate the applicability of proposed approach.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ control of uncertain nonlinear continuous-time singular semi-Markov jump systems
abstract: The robust state feedback H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control problem for a class of uncertain nonlinear continuous-time singular semi-Markov jump systems is discussed in this paper. First, based on stochastic Lyapunov functional, a sufficient condition is established, which guarantees the uncertain nonlinear continuous-time singular semi-Markov jump systems are stochastically admissible and satisfy H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance. With this condition, based on the bounds of the time-varying transition probability, an LMI sufficient condition is given such that the singular semi-Markov jump systems are stochastically admissible and satisfy H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance. Then, the state feedback H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller design is developed in the LMI frame. Last, one numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the obtained method.

articleTitle: Safe operation improvement of an electrical power system by superconducting fault current limiters
abstract: As microgrid grows and will become more interconnected, high short-circuit current level is a serious problem, which will threaten the safe and stable operation of power system. Superconducting fault current limiter (SFCL) is mainly used to solve the problem and can limit a prodigious short-circuit current to a lower level so that the protection devices can be operated safely. This paper is aimed towards the problem of utilizing SFCL with the purpose of safe operation enhancement of medium-low voltage microgrid network. The power grid model was built by using Simulink and SimPowerSystem blocks in Matlab according to the actual power system. In the case of interconnection power grid with different voltage levels, an appropriate resistance value could be obtained by analyzing the relationship between fault current reduction and the resistance value of SFCL in the same voltage level. The investigation on how to use SFCL to limit fault current level was conducted by utilizing the built model. The power grid fault occurred in middle or low voltage distribution network was simulated and the impact of SFCL on fault current reduction was evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on the rotary-linear motion magnetic gear based on ANSYS
abstract: In this paper, the structure, features and operating principles of the rotational-linear magnetic drive gear based on the principles of the linear motor are analyzed. Using finite element analysis software ANSYS, 2-D and 3-D equivalent model on the overall structure of are established. Through model analysis, the design size of magnetic gear, its performance parameters are discussed. The curves of each parameter and the magnetic force, including the magnetic pole arc, the air gap thickness and tooth thickness are plotted. Considering the processing level of practical engineering, the magnetic gear structure is optimized. The simulation experiment on optimized structure verifies the feasibility of the improved structure.

articleTitle: Fuzzy approximation-based adaptive command filtered control for induction motors
abstract: This paper considers the problem of the adaptive speed regulation command filtered control for induction motors drive system with parameter uncertainties based on fuzzy-approximation. Fuzzy logic systems are used to approximate the unknown nonlinear functions. The adaptive command filtered backstepping is employed to construct controllers which can overcome the problem “explosion of complexity” inherent in the traditional backstepping design and guarantee the tracking error can converge to a small neighborhood of the origin. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Initial research on stability margin of nonlinear systems under additive-state-decomposition-based control framework
abstract: The study on the stability margin of nonlinear systems is difficult and meaningful. This paper makes an initial research on the stability margin for a nonlinear system with the unmodeled higher-order uncertainty. Three stabilizing control methods are tried, and the additive-state-decomposition-based control is the best compared with the other two. The first control method is the feedback linearization control, which may lead to a singularity problem. To avoid the singularity, a backstepping controller is further designed. However, it is still hard to analyze the system stability margin due to the nonlinearity. For such a purpose, the third control method, namely additive-state-decomposition-based control, is proposed to overcome both problems above. Under the additive-state-decomposition-based control framework, the stability margin of the nonlinear system is studied by the Bode plot method, which can be realized via a data-driven method. Finally, a series compensator is designed to compensate for the unmodeled higher-order uncertainty, and make the system stability margin satisfy the design specification. The comparison of the three methods and the verification of the validity of stability margin are illustrated by the simulation.

articleTitle: Distributed coordinated control of multiple underactuated marine surface vehicles along one curve
abstract: This paper investigates the coordination problem for multiple underacutated marine surface vehicles (MSVs) along one curve. The dedicated control designs are categorized into two envelopes. One is to steer individual underactuated MSV to track the given spatial path, and the other is to force the vehicles dispersed on a parameterized path. With these two tasks formulation, a coordinated path following controller is developed based on a line-of-sight guidance law and a new path variable containment design approach. Specifically, the vehicle coordination is achieved by adapting the speed of the vehicles, such that the path variables of the vehicles are uniformly dispersed between those of two virtual leaders. The path following control subsystem and the coordination control subsystem form a cascade system, which is shown to be uniform global asymptotic stable. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the new coordination method.

articleTitle: Output feedback robust MPC subject to input saturation based on input-output model
abstract: This paper presents a synthesis approach of output feedback robust model predictive control for the system with both polytopic uncertainty and bounded disturbance. The system is represented by a input-output model such that the requirement of on-line estimating system's state is not required. Earlier results are extended by selecting a Lyapunov matrix with full dimension and considering input saturation. Compared with the previous result, the conservatism of controller design is decreased. The on-line calculated controller can guarantee that the closed-loop system converge to a neighborhood of origin. A continuous stirred tank reactor control system is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Dissipativity-based fault estimation observer design for linear multi-agent systems with disturbances
abstract: This paper concerns with the dissipativity-based fault estimation of linear multi-agent systems with actuator faults. Using linear matrix inequality (LMI) and dissipativity theory, a sufficient condition is firstly presented for a dynamic system to be dissipative. The observer is constructed based on relative output estimation error. Then the existence condition of dissipativity-based fault estimation observers is shown by means of LMI. According to the solution of LMI, the design method of the observer is given. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensor placement strategy for a hypersonic vehicle with elastic effects
abstract: This paper focuses on the sensor placement strategy for a hypersonic vehicle with elastic effects. A rate gyroscope is modeled to measure the pitch rate of a hypersonic vehicle. Since the elastic effects is being considered, the measured pitch rate would be affected by the elastic mode shape of the vehicle, resulting in a difference between the real and measured pitch rate. Since the elastic states of the vehicle cannot be measured directly, this paper develops the sensor placement strategy to enhance the observability of the system. Then, by applying the vehicle's velocity and altitude as reference tracking commands, this paper develops an output feedback control law with observer for the vehicle. Simulation results for different sensor placement position are given to show the strategy and effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Compliance control for grasping with a bionic robot hand
abstract: A compliance control method is proposed for grasping objects in this paper. A bionic robot hand with force sensor and five under-actuated fingers is presented. To analyze the influence of robot hand spring stiffness and object stiffness on the dynamic response, the system characteristics of tendon-driven robot hand is studied. Compliance controller is designed to improve the response characteristics of the system. Experiments on the SHU-II robot hand are carried out, and the results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The research on the coordinated control system of PID neural network based on artificial fish swarm algorithm
abstract: The large-scale unit power plant is a typical multiple-inputs and multiple-outputs system, which is of time-delaying, time-varying, nonlinear, strong coupling, and dynamic characteristics variation characteristics. The coordinated control system is the most important and complex system in thermal power plant, and its control effect affects the operating condition of the unit. The PID neural network is applied to the coordinated control system, which optimizes the traditional PID control system, but there are some problems when selecting the initial weights. The article uses the coordinated control system of PID neural network based on artificial fish swarm algorithm, and by simulation, the system improve the control effect and meet the control requirements.

Author Keywords: Map classification number: TP273 Document identification code A

articleTitle: Measurement of acoustic wave travel-time in grain bulk
abstract: Acoustic temperature measurement method uses the dependence of sound speed in materials on temperature along the sound propagation path. The measurement of acoustic wave travel-time in grain bulk has been researched in this paper for monitoring grain temperature by acoustic method. A measurement system of sound travel-time based on the virtual instrument is described. Transmitted signals include chirp and maximum length sequence (MLS). Travel-time of sound waves is calculated by cross-correlating the signals received by two microphones. Experiment results show that stable measurement values of sound travel-times in grain can be obtained by MLS combined with cross-correlation. Compared with chirp, MLS can provide much higher measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: The robot motion trajectory algorithm research based on B-spline and new velocity planning
abstract: To obtain the ability of machining free-form curve trajectory accurately for open Welding robot system based on LinuxCNC, this paper directed at the traditional speed control algorithms which can't achieve efficiency requirements and proposed new velocity control algorithm. The paper also studied the B-Spline mathematic model and its interpolation principle based on the new control algorithm, proposed three B-Spline curve Instantaneous velocity interpolation algorithm and the design steps of B-Spline curve interpolation algorithm in LinuxCNC system. The experimental simulation results showed that B-Spline interpolation algorithm can realize free-form curve tracking in LinuxCNC system, and showed a good curve run effect in the preview screen.

articleTitle: Prediction of the wind speed series based on genetic hysteretic Elman network
abstract: A hysteretic Elman neural network is proposed to improve the prediction performance of the wind speed series. A hysteretic function which is constructed by shifting the Sigmoid function is used as the activation function of the neuron in the context layer. The historical information can be used in the process of choosing the activation response branch. Genetic algorithm is used to train the parameters in the hysteretic Elman neural network. The known data are used to construct the training samples. Multi-step prediction of the wind speed series are performed by the hysteretic Elman neural network. Simulation results show that the better prediction results can be got by the hysteretic Elman neural network and prediction errors can be reduced.

articleTitle: A research about remote flow control based on IOT
abstract: This paper comes up with a new heating system based on Internet of Things in order to get rid of Chinese current situation where existing systems cost much energy and manpower, work inefficient and rigid, and fall behind the times. The following is the main ideas of our new system: This system installs some special temperature sensors. There is LCD Display on the temperature sensor, which is used to inform users about information of indoor temperature, outdoor temperature and payment. According to requirement of themselves, users could select different heating mode by using APP provided by this system to send commands. This system installs some network controller in each layer of housing estate, which could gather the information of the temperature sensors, users and the ball valve controllers and send information to IPC. At the same time, the network controllers would send commands to the ball valve controllers so as to control heating, and IPC would send information to the server. In addition, users could pay the fees of heating by using APP. This paper mainly discusses and introduces design and realization of this new system.

articleTitle: Modeling and control of tilt-rotor aircraft
abstract: In this paper, a flight dynamics model of a tiltrotor aircraft is developed used basic equations of motion. This model focuses on control aspect of tiltrotor and is able to show inherent tiltrotor characteristics; then a flight control system is designed used novel L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> adaptive control theory. The XV-15 tilt rotor aircraft is taken as an example to verify this modeling method and flight control system; finally, numerical simulations are presented to show the performance and robustness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: A bat-inspired particle filter for visual tracking
abstract: Particle filters perform the nonlinear estimation and have been proven to be a powerful tool in solving visual tracking problems. However, the problem of sample impoverishment is still a drawback of particle filter. To solve this problem, a bat-inspired particle filter is proposed in this work. The particles in the particle filter are optimized using a new biologically inspired optimization algorithm, namely bat algorithm before re-sampling. The meaningful particles are increased and they can approximate the true state of the target more accurately. Experiments on visual tracking show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the standard particle filter and it can track targets accurately and robustly in various challenging conditions.

articleTitle: The off-site severe accident consequence analysis in the nuclear power plant
abstract: At present, more and more attentions are paid to the off-site consequence analysis of the severe accident in the nuclear power plant. In this paper, the programs, MELCOR and MACCS, are integrated into the full scope simulator to process the off-site consequence analysis of the severe accident in the nuclear power station. Through the full scope simulator, MACCS can automatically receive the radioactive source term data from MELCOR, and then it calculates the release of radioactive fission products inside and outside the containment according to the local site meteorological data. The areas, where the radiation dose exceeds regulatory limit and people need to be shielded or evacuated, are displayed on the simulator in the form of dynamic map. The off-site severe accident consequence analysis is testified by using the data of one of CPR1000 nuclear power plants in China. The result shows that this method not only expands the scope of application of simulator, but also supplements and improves the severe accident analysis, which can be taken as the reference of the off-site emergency plan.

articleTitle: Analysis of the self-escape trajectories for manned spacecraft
abstract: This paper focuses on the trajectories analysis of the self-escape technology for the manned spacecraft. The pusher type launch escape system was selected to establish the whole model. According to the analyzing of characteristic trajectories in different escape phases, the goal of safe escaping is achieved. Also, the system accomplishes the objectives of reducing launch weight, minimizing complexity and enabling potential reuse. For the ground escape stage, we present analysis results of the trajectories of the self-provided propulsion ship. We mainly consider the features and influencing factors of the height, the course range, and the directional escape direction angle, based on the obtained representative trajectories. Further, we consider the escape problem with a certain direction angle. The escape direction angle is proportional to the working time of the yaw attitude engine, while the working time of the pitch attitude engine is fixed.

articleTitle: An improved droop control with tunable virtual impedance
abstract: A droop control with tunable virtual impedance based on the cloud model theory is proposed in the paper. Because of the imbalance feeder impedance in low voltage micro-grid, it is difficult for the traditional droop control to get good performance. The tunable virtual impedance is needed to conquer these problems due to the difficulty of getting the changing feeder impedance. The virtual impedance contains the virtual minus resistor and the tunable virtual impedance. The virtual minus resistor not only can avoid the power couple because of the high resistive line, but decrease the output voltage descending for the parallel system. The tunable virtual impedance is added in the traditional PQ droop control for the proposed control strategy. The cloud membership theory is used to obtain the changing feeder impedance online according to the relationship between the changing feeder impedance and the loop current. The feasibility of the proposed control strategy is verified by the simulated results in a low voltage micro-grid prototype.

articleTitle: Radar fault diagnosis based on improved chaos genetic algorithm
abstract: Based on the research of rough set theory and chaos genetic algorithm, a chaos genetic algorithm based on knowledge dependence is proposed and applied to fault diagnosis of radar. In this algorithm, the binary initial population is restricted by the attribute kernel, and the dependence of the decision attribute to the condition attribute is introduced in the fitness function, and the new design of the crossover probability and mutation probability is proposed, and the new generation of the new generation of individuals is increased. Using the algorithm to diagnose the fault of the radar, the diagnosis rules corresponding to the fault symptoms and fault causes are acquired, and the fault diagnosis system based on fault tree is avoided.

articleTitle: The high pressure water mist fire extinguishing system based on Anylogic modeling
abstract: This paper introduces the high pressure water mist fire extinguishing systems and latest research progress and developments in domestic and foreign, and the use of high pressure water mist extinguishing in Anylogic build system simulation model. It not only greatly reduces the high pressure water mist fire extinguishing system research equipment investment costs, but also makes up for the actual installation and commissioning of the entire system. Meanwhile it can change poor, high costs less, and better apply the control theory in which high pressure water mist fire extinguishing system. This study presents a high pressure water mist fire extinguishing system simulation model based on system dynamics, and the model proposed for the high-pressure water mist control technology development in the country and improve the model it provides an important foundation.

articleTitle: The influencing factors of fresh agricultural products logistics in liaoning Province based on the analytic hierarchy process
abstract: Fresh agricultural products are always weak in both rural economy development and agricultural logistics development of China. In this paper, according to the investigations of fresh agricultural products market and the practitioners in five areas of Liaoning province, we use the analytic hierarchy process to analyze the influencing factors of fresh agricultural products logistics in these five areas. The analysis shows that the infrastructure and the geographical position are the key factors. Then the application level of logistics technology and the government's policy supporting need to be improved. Meanwhile the logistics infrastructure construction of fresh agricultural products and the application of advanced logistics technology should be strengthened, the policy on fresh agricultural products logistics development should be improved and the major participants' consciousness of modern logistics should also be improved. Finally the government should focus on supporting the fresh agricultural logistics development in remote and rural areas as well.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of discrete-time quadratic periodically time-varying systems with input saturation
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to stability analysis for discrete-time quadratic periodically time-varying systems with input saturation. The concept of so-called periodic contractively invariant set is employed to analyze the open-loop stability or closed-loop stability. As a result, sufficient conditions for local stability and stabilization are derived in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) and LMIs-based optimization problems are then given to estimate the stability region of the corresponding systems. Finally, a simulation example is presented to illustrate the efficiency of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Iterative learning control for switched linear parabolic systems in space W1, 2
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of iterative learning control for a class of switched linear parabolic systems in space W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,2</sup>. Here, the considered switched systems with arbitrary switching rules are operated during a finite time interval repetitively. According to the characteristics of the systems, iterative learning control laws are proposed for such switched parabolic systems based on the P-type learning algorithm. Using the contraction mapping method, it is shown that the algorithm can guarantee the output tracking errors on W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,2</sup> space converge along the iteration axis. A simulation example illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Space-indexed aircraft trajectory tracking
abstract: Future Air Traffic Management (ATM) demands that flights to be more efficient while maintaining safety and improving flight predictability. Two major research groups Single European Sky (SESAR) and Next Generation Air Transportation system (NEXTGEN) are progressively researching on the concept of 4D trajectory management which aims to improve flight efficiency by integrating time into the 3D trajectory. Therefore the implementation of time-space based flight guidance controller will be investigated in this paper. Firstly, the reference tracking error equations with respect to the spatial variable is defined and later transformed into a reference tracking error with respect to time. Using nonlinear dynamic inversion, the control law is established to make the aircraft accurately follow 3D+T desired trajectories. A simulation is performed to explore the feasibility of the proposed guidance control law and it was found that the proposed guidance control law is able to accurately follow a 3D+T reference trajectory at the same time follow the overfly time constraint.

articleTitle: H∞ controller design for continuous networked control systems based on a switched system approach
abstract: In this paper, the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller design problem is investigated for continuous networked control systems (NCSs). Based on a switched system approach, we establish a novel NCSs model, by which the proposed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller changes along with the system modes. By using Lyapunov stability theory and Wirtinger-based integral inequality, sufficient conditions for the mean square stability and stabilization of the continuous networked control systems are achieved. Finally, two simulation examples are exploited to demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of the presented controller design method.

articleTitle: A novel quadratic programming based model-free adaptive control for I/O constrained nonlinear systems
abstract: A novel quadratic programming (QP) based model-free adaptive control approach is proposed in this work to deal with constrained nonlinear discrete-time systems. Three types of constraints are considered together in this work, i.e., the constraints on the boundary of control input, the boundary of system output, as well as the change rate of control input between two time instants. All these constraints are transferred into a unified linear matrix inequality (LMI). Then, a control input index function is designed with respect to control errors and control input changes in a quadratic form. The control law is attained by minimizing the index function subjected to the LMI via quadratic programming (QP). The designed approach is data-based only and does not need an exactly linear model. Both theoretical and simulative results verify that the proposed approach is effective to applications. the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Nano satellite attitude estimation with magnetometer and photodiodes measurements
abstract: A method of integrating measurements of a tri-axis magnetometer and body-mounted photodiodes for nano-satellites which require low power consumption and light weight is introduced in this paper. By applying sunlight vector measured by photodiodes and earth magnetic field vector by magnetometer, two observation equations are specifically established for sunlight and umbra areas of the orbit, and attitude estimation is obtained through Kalman filtering. This method is practical in engineering application. Simulation analysis shows that error of estimation by this algorithm is acceptable and does not accumulate over time.

articleTitle: Self-tuning control scheme of non-uniformly sampled data systems with time delay and unknown colored noise
abstract: This paper is motivated by the practical control considerations that non-uniformly sampled data systems with time delay and unknown colored noise (NUDSTC) are abundant in industrial process. First of all, the lifted state space model of NUDSTC is derived and the corresponding input-output relationship is obtained. Next, a recursive general extended identification algorithm is used to estimate the parameters of the non-uniformly sampled data systems. According to optimization control principle, the acquired model of NUDSTC derived from the identification algorithm is decomposed into the multiple sub-models. Further, the overall adaptive control scheme of non-uniformly sampled data system is obtained by finishing the combination of the minimum variance self-tuning controllers of sub-models. Finally, the simulation example is studied to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Overlapping robust decentralized connective stabilization for interconnected systems with loop structure via dynamic state feedback
abstract: An overlapping robust decentralized connective stabilization method based on dynamic state feedback is proposed for a kind of large-scale interconnected systems with loop topological structure. Firstly, the state space of an interconnected system is expanded by using inclusion principle of large-scale systems and the system is divided into a series of pair-wise subsystems in the expanded space. Then, the robust decentralized controllers based on dynamic state feedback for each pair-wise subsystem are designed by using LMI method and Lyapunov theory. Next, the designed repeatedly controllers for every subsystem are contracted back to the original space. Coordination of the control laws can be achieved, so that the original interconnected system is robust connectively stable. Finally, the proposed method is applied to AGC control design of a three-area interconnected power system with loop structure. Simulation results show the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Distributed H∞ node-to-node consensus via aperiodic sampled-data pinning control
abstract: This paper investigates the distributed H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> node-to-node consensus of multi-agent systems with a leaders' layer and a followers' layer. The dynamics of each agent are described by nonlinear differential equations and the communication topology is directed. The information communication within the same layer is continuous while aperiodic sampled-data pinning control is utilized between the leaders' layer and the followers' layer. By employing novel Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals and convex approach, sufficient criteria are derived to guarantee the states of each followers to track those of the corresponding leaders exponentially while keeping the desired H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance.

articleTitle: Zero element row augmenting path algorithm for linear assignment problems
abstract: A zero element row augmenting path algorithm is proposed for linear assignment problems. Under the algorithm, the maximum element in an assignment y is picked firstly, where y is calculated according to the reduced matrix of a given cost matrix at the initial stage. According to each row's zero element record and starting from the row containing the picked element, a zero element row augmenting path is computed while the cost matrix is further reduced and the zero element record of each row is updated. Finally, y is adjusted according to the augmenting path so that the number of the zero elements in y can increase strictly. The above process is repeated until y is an optimal assignment. Extensive computational experiments are carried out and indicate that the proposed algorithm is even faster than the shortest augmenting algorithm.

Author Keywords: Hungarian Method and Shortest Augmenting Path Algorithm

articleTitle: Impact time control guidance law using virtual leader and dynamic inversion
abstract: For the requirements of multi-missile salvo attack, a guidance law based on virtual leader and dynamic inversion is proposed in this article. The key idea of the law is to adopt a virtual leader for real missiles. This method can convert a guidance problem with time constraints to a nonlinear tracking problem. The missile is guided by a combination of the conventional PNG law and a maneuver control. Using the method of dynamic inversion can solve the maneuver control command which can control the impact-time. The simulation results show that the guidance law can control impact-time of missile very well. Besides, this method doesn't need to estimate the remaining time. What's more, the problem of not controlling the impact-time is solved when the heading angle is 0° or 180°. The guidance law can also control the rate of convergence and the calculation is relatively simple. When used for multi-missile salvo attack, the simulation results also verify the validity of the guidance law well.

articleTitle: Finite-time tracking for underactuated vehicles with parametric uncertainties
abstract: This paper investigates a global tracking problem for underactuated vehicles with parameter uncertainties. Firstly, the system is divided into two subsystems according to its inherent structure. Secondly, a controller and a desired time-variant angular velocity are designed by Backstepping approach; meanwhile, there is another controller designed by NTSM to ensure angular and angular velocity converge to their desired ones. Thirdly, global asymptotical convergence and finite-time convergence are demonstrated by Barbalat Lemma and the theory of sliding mode. Finally, simulation results are provided to show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: The model reference adaptive control method of submerged arc welding power supply system
abstract: According to the Mathematical model of control system for submerged arc welding power source, using the model reference adaptive control method to control a given voltage including two kinds of variables wire feeding speed to achieve constant current power supply current characteristic and the stability of arc length. With super stability theory, the control system based on Matlab/Simulink platform and the simulation experiment. And according to the experimental results under submerged arc welding power supply control system with PID algorithm were compared. The conclusion shows that the model reference adaptive control method can well guarantee the power supply current cross flow characteristics and stability of the arc length, and ensure the welding effect compared with the traditional PID control.

Author Keywords: Submerged arc welding power supply system

articleTitle: MR image de-noising algorithm based on improved weickert structure tensor model
abstract: In allusion to P-M do not take the directional construction of local image into consideration, and to solve the false edge caused by using Weickert diffusion tensor to process the flat part of the image. A MR image de-noising algorithm based on improved Weickert diffusion tensor model has been proposed in this paper, by using continuous threshold, selecting appropriate eigenvalue modification method timely, and combining edge enhancement and coherent enhancement's eigenvalue together. Experiments are implemented on Lena image and brain MR images, and the average index of MSE, SNR, PSNR under different noise levels have been gotten. Compared to P-M model, EDD and CED, our algorithm achieved the best result. The experiment results showed that the algorithm can effectively remove noises from MR image.

articleTitle: The innovation research of low carbon building energy
abstract: Currently, global warming has become the most pressing problem that the people need to solve. The key to solve this problem is to control energy consumption and carbon emissions effectively. Although our country has obvious progress in low carbon technology innovation and development, compared with some developed countries we still have a long way to go, especially in the problem of energy consumption in the construction industry. So we must introduce low-carbon building technology in our country. Technology transfer is an important means of access to technology source, but Chinese low carbon building technology innovation mechanism is not perfect now, which restricted the development of technological innovation in low carbon buildings in our country. The purpose of this paper is to study how to improve the low carbon buildings in our country through technology transfer technology innovation level, and provide some advices for our country's low carbon architectural technology development.

articleTitle: Study on comprehensive assessment system of software reliability
abstract: From the five aspects of software nature's reliability, analyzing and designing phase's reliability, encoding phase's reliability, testing phase's reliability and hardware environment's reliability, software reliability comprehensive assessment indicator system has been established, and based on method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, software reliability comprehensive assessment model has been established.

articleTitle: Co-design of controller and communication sequences
abstract: The problem of co-design of controller and communication sequence is addressed for networked control systems (NCSs) where the capacities of communication networks at both sides of the system are limited so that the sensors and the actuators cannot be accommodated simultaneously. The co-design problem is solved in three steps: determining feasible communication sequence sets for both sides; building output feedback controllers on the feasible communication sequence sets; setting up switching rules for the communication sequences based on the designed controller. Particularly, in the first step we find all the communication sequences that preserve controllability and observability of the plant; then in the second step we derive an output feedback controller applicable for all these communication sequences; and finally we establish a switching strategy for the communication sequences to switch among their feasible sets.

articleTitle: Design of vehicle rescue information interaction system based on embedded technology
abstract: In order to make sure the injured person can get rescue without delay, A vehicle rescuing information interaction system was designed, which consists of two parts, vehicle embedded system and rescue center terminal. This system works on a core control chip S3C2440. It uses GPS technology to let the Latitude and Longitude information about a car is acquired, to monitor a moving car's angular speed and accelerated speed by tori axial acceleration sensor. It also uses the Kalman filtering algorithm to do the data fusion, to get the vehicle pitch angle, roll angles and attitude 3D modeling display. We can get the conclusion from the comprehensive test and simulation experiment results. It turns out that the system has a well stabled interactive performance, it can improve the efficiency while rescuing the vehicle and injured people. It has a certain practical meaning.

articleTitle: Damaged modelling for supersonic near space vehicles under vertical tail loss
abstract: The paper intends to study modeling for structural damage of supersonic near space vehicles (SNSV). Firstly, the nominal attitude mode for supersonic near space vehicles (SNSV) is introduced. Secondly, damage effects for aerodynamic parameters generated by vertical tail loss are analyzed. Then, aerodynamic parameters curves are simulated via recalculated those related aerodynamic parameter values, consequently, the updated aerodynamic derivatives can be further obtained. Finally, in the state cruising, damaged modeling for the attitude dynamics system under vertical tail loss is established. This project could provide controllable model and further solve the safety problem for body-structure-damage of supersonic near space vehicle, which can reduce the risk of flying disasters.

articleTitle: Finite-time state feedback control of linear systems with sampled-data measurement
abstract: In this paper, finite-time state feedback control problem is addressed for a class of linear sampled-data systems. Based on mixed continuous and discrete analysis, sufficient conditions are presented such that the closed-loop system with the sampled-data measurement is finite-time boundedness (FTB). The derived conditions can be transformed into the feasibility problem of LMIs and can be easily checked by Matlab LMI Toolbox. Finally, examples are given to show the validity of the methodology.

articleTitle: Disturbance observer based backstepping sliding mode dynamic positioning control for UUV under wave disturbance
abstract: In order to solve the four degrees of freedom dynamic positioning control problem under the wave disturbance for UUV(Unmanned Underwater Vehicle), disturbance observer based backstepping sliding mode controller is proposed. Firstly, the four degrees of freedom dynamic positioning simplified motion mode is established, then the sliding mode control law is designed based on backstepping method. Secondly, the disturbance observer is adopted to estimate the wave disturbance online in order to have an equivalent compensation. At last, a thruster allocation method is proposed based on the thrusters of the researched UUV. The stability of the whole controller is proved, and simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can improve the control accuracy, and it also has robustness under the wave disturbance.

articleTitle: The study of channel members advertising strategies subject to Nerlove-Arrow model with lagged effect
abstract: Based on a modified Nerlove-Arrow (N-A) model, we discuss the optimal advertising strategy problem in a single-manufacturer-single-retailer supply chain. Here, the N-A model is allowed to be influenced by the advertising behaviors with the lagged effect. By applying the differential game theory, the optimal advertising strategies of channel members are obtained under the decentralized and centralized systems. The comparison between two scenarios shows that the optimal advertising efforts of channel members in the centralized system are higher than those in the decentralized system. Also, the channel profit is higher in the centralized one, when the delay time is falling within the closed field. Finally, a number example is given to show the change of channel profit with delay time.

articleTitle: Globally controlled consensus criteria for Networked Multi-Agent Systems with different agent dynamics and time delays
abstract: The controlled consensus problem of Networked Multi-Agent Systems (NMAS) consisting of different agent dynamics is investigated in this manuscript. Integrating with the pinning control method and direct adaptive control method, the global bounded consensus criteria is deviated. The consensus criteria obtained makes all agents dynamics achieve consensus in the sense of boundedness. Meanwhile, many previous consensus results referring to the identical case can be viewed as special cases of the present results. Finally, numerical simulations are discussed by demonstrating the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A delay-dependent stability criterion for a class of systems with time-varying delay
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of a delay-dependent stability criterion for a class of time-varying delay systems. A Lyapunov functional is constructed by dividing the whole delay interval into sub-intervals according to the time-delay decomposition method. Taking terms of the Lyapunov functional as a whole to examine its positive definite. A less conservative stability criterion is derived in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally examining the effectiveness of the stability criterion by an example.

articleTitle: Hybrid electric vehicle torque distribution based on the optimal operating curve and multi-input
abstract: In order to reduce the fuel consumption of hybrid electric vehicles, comprehensively considering the efficiency of engine, motor, power battery pack and transmission system, a hybrid electric vehicle torque distribution strategy based on the optimal operating curve and multi-input is proposed. First of all, using the adaptive genetic algorithm, the optimal operating point of engine is optimized. Then, the vehicle torque distribution is realized by three layer feedforward neural network. The auxiliary torque provided by motor is used to adjust the real-time operating point of engine and keep engine and motor working in the optimum efficiency area. Meanwhile, the weights of neural network are updated by the temporal difference method to realize the real-time control of system. Finally, based on the xPC target hardware in-the-loop system and by selecting the NEDC conditions to make simulation, the result of simulation demonstrates the effectiveness of the torque distribution strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: H∞ output feedback control for polytopic Delta operator systems
abstract: The problem of dynamic output-feedback H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control for polytopic Delta operator systems is investigated. Based on Bounded Real Lemma, an improved presentation of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance is proposed. Upon this performance criterion, a developed parameter-dependent approach is used to design a robust output-feedback controller. A sufficient condition for dynamic output-feedback H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> controller is derived in terms of matrix inequalities. The designed controller can be obtained from the solution of an iteration method. The proposed controller design procedure is less conservative. A numerical example is given to test the feasibility and advantage of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Event-triggered robust H control for networked control system with sensor faults
abstract: This paper investigates the robust H∞ controller design problem for networked control system (NCS). In the system modeling, both the event-triggered control scheme and failure modes of sensors are considered. Then a new comprehensive approach integrating reciprocal convex combination method and Lyapunov stability theory is proposed. Based on this kind comprehensive approach, two sufficient conditions in form of linear matrix inequalities for the system stabilization and H∞ performance are derived. Finally the system stabilization and effectiveness of the fault-tolerant controller are verified by encouraging simulation results.

articleTitle: Boost converter optimal control based on MFAC and FPSOA under model mismatch
abstract: An optimal control of boost converter based on model-free adaptive controller (MFAC) and fuzzy particle swarm optimization algorithm (FPSOA) is proposed to realize a better response performance and robustness under model mismatch and the parameter time variation. The data-based MFAC is investigated to design the boost converter, which avoids the precise modeling and greatly reduces the influence of model mismatch. Additionally, the FPSOA is used for online optimization of the controller parameters to improve the response performance and robustness. Comparing with the traditional optimal control methods of boost converter, the proposed method avoids the contradiction of establishing accurate model and complex systems design. It inhibits the influences of the parameter time variation and model mismatch, and has a better dynamic and static performance. Finally, the test is implemented on a semi-physical simulation platform for power electronic control systems. The comparison of MFAC and classic state feedback exact linearization control in various model mismatch situations are used to show the effectiveness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Impulsive consensus for second-order multi-agent systems based on asynchronous sampled information
abstract: This paper studies the consensus problem of second-order agents with impulsive protocol and asynchronous sampling information. It is assumed that each agent measures the relative position information to the neighbors and its velocity information at its own clock. For different agents, the measurement times are independent of each other. By only reducing the order of stacked velocity vector and common Lyapunov function, it is proved that there exist protocol parameters ensuring consensus. Also, the design of the parameters can be given by solving a linear matrix inequality. Finally, simulation example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Input-to-state stable MPC algorithms for constrained LPV systems
abstract: This paper presents a new robust model predictive control (MPC) algorithm for a class of constrained uncertain linear parameter-varying (LPV) systems, where the current value of the parameter can be measured in realtime and the uncertain disturbance can be bounded, but unknown non-vanishing additive disturbances. Parameter-dependent MPC laws are developed so that it becomes self-scheduling via time-varying parameters measured in real-time, which offers potential performance improvements over a fixed robust controller. Furthermore, the notions of input-to-state stability and robust positively invariant set are used to regain the recursive feasibility and closed-loop input-to-state stability with respect to the disturbance. Finally, an example is used to illustrate the effectiveness of results obtained here.

articleTitle: SIVR spreading model with anti-virus factor in complex networks
abstract: Complex networks portray a multitude of interactions through which infectious diseases propagate in a society. Tight attraction has been focus on the dynamics of epidemic spreading in complex networks. In this paper, a new epidemic spreading model with anti-virus, Susceptible-Infected-Variant-Recovery (SIVR) model, is proposed. This model extends the classical Susceptible-Infected-Recovery (SIR) epidemic spreading model with considering anti-virus class affection. Mean-field equations are derived by describing the dynamics behaviors of the SIVR model in complex networks. Then steady-state analysis for this model is conducted to investigate the process of epidemic spreading under different spreading rate, recovery rate, variant rate, and the average degree of networks. Meanwhile, epidemic immunization strategies are discussed for the immunization threshold in homogeneous networks. Numerical simulations are conducted to illustrate the relationship between the factors of the epidemic spreading. It is found that contact variant rate accelerates the epidemic terminal time and increases the maximum epidemic influence.

articleTitle: Acoustic source localization based quantized information for wireless sensor networks
abstract: Communication bandwidth and energy was limited in Wireless sensor networks, hence it is possible to reduce the network overhead by transmitting the quantized information. This paper conducted a research on the target localization method of wireless sensor networks, adopting an acoustics energy attenuation model. Firstly, the strategy of logarithmic quantization based on the attenuation characteristic of acoustic energy was proposed. Then deduced a likelihood function based on quantized information. Finally, conducted the unknown acoustic source localization using the maximum likelihood method. The simulation results indicated that the proposed method was able to estimate the location of unknown acoustic source relatively accurately. Therefore, on the premise of satisfying the localization accuracy, it was possible to save the energy of network by reducing the number of bits transmitted.

articleTitle: Target re-identification based on histogram comparison by optimized diffusion distance
abstract: Target re-identification from cross-cameras is a difficult problem in the field of multiple camera surveillance, which needs to be urgently solved. In this paper, we introduced a new measurement algorithm: Optimized Diffusion Distance, which needn't supervision and adapt to more scenes. As for the algorithm, firstly, we extract multiple features of targets, and then compute the optimized diffusion distance of each feature's histogram. In order to reduce the differences between the features, normalization processing is needed. Finally, a general similarity measure function will be get by assigning the appropriate weighted value. And the experiments based on VIPeR show that this algorithm could achieve good matching results.

articleTitle: Research of the incipient fault detection method for an airfoil based on near flutter analysis
abstract: On the problem of preventing and reducing flight accidents, the incipient fault detection for an airfoil has important significance of enhancing the safety and reliability of aircrafts. Because offline detection approaches cannot detect small incipient faults in time, a new online frequency domain analysis method based on near flutter analysis of an airfoil is proposed. With this approach, fault detection can be accomplished by limited samples online. Small faults of an airfoil which is hard to detect in normal conditions is amplified by the near flutter condition through this method. Then amplified signals are processed through the frequency domain analysis method. So we built a simulation model for two-dimensional pitch and plunge apparatus to verify the fault detection method. Finally, the simulation results show that the approach based on near flutter analysis not only can detect incipient faults, but also can detect different fault conditions of an airfoil.

articleTitle: The propagation characteristics of oblique incident ultrasonic waves in damage coating steel
abstract: Aiming at the problem of damaged pipeline corrosion protection, the propagation characteristics of oblique incident wave in single layer and double layer were studied. Three kinds of different frequency probes were placed on damage coating steel plate, intact coating steel plate and damage coating boundary. The three groups of experimental amplitude and the difference of nonlinear were obtained when the frequencies are not the same. The results show that when the frequency is 5MHz, the amplitude of the damage coating steel plate is larger than the intact coating steel plate. And the attenuation of amplitude in the intact coating steel plate is about 1/3, the nonlinearity is not obvious. When the probe is placed on the damage coating boundary, the echo signal is obviously nonlinear. The damage detection of steel plate corrosion protection layer can be carried out based on oblique incidence ultrasonic waves.

articleTitle: The design of underground crop digging robot and its control method
abstract: With the aging population, the shortage of labor become more obviously especially in some remote mountainous areas. The labor shortage has brought many problems. In order to solve these problems, one kind underground crop digging robot has been designed, which could adapt to the mountain and plain. The electricity power was used as the driving force. The machine body of the robot was composed of scarification mechanism and conveyer belt. This robot was contained motor, reducer, sensor and other machine structure. Used the AT89C51 microcontroller, the control mean achieve MCU control. Two photoelectric sensors were used to automatically dig by the track ridge of crop. This robot possesses light and small, automatically digging track ridge of crop.

articleTitle: A method for emergency plan evaluation under group decision makers based on 2-tuple prioritized OWA operator
abstract: This study investigates the group decision making under linguistic fuzzy environment in which the criteria are in different priority level in the emergency plan evaluation, the 2-tuple prioritized ordered weighted average (2TPOWA) operator is defined. Some properties on the 2TPOWA operator are presented. Based on priority relationship, the method of determining the weighting vector related with the operator is proposed. A new method for criteria with different priority under linguistic fuzzy environment utilizing the 2TPOWA operator is developed. Finally, a practical example is provided to illustrate the developed method.

articleTitle: Agglomeration detection in gas-phase ethylene polymerization based on the Gaussian of acoustic signal
abstract: An agglomeration detection method based on the Gaussian of acoustic signal is proposed for the gas-phase Ethylene polymerization. The forming mechanism of acoustic pressure in Fluid Bed Reactor (FBR) is analyzed first. Based on the analysis, the kurtosis of the acoustic signal is extracted as the feature to predict the changing in particle size distribution (PSD) of polymer within FBR. To avoid the repeated false alarms due to the repeatability of agglomeration, the distribution parameter of kurtosis is introduced as the output of detection method. The alarm threshold is determined based on the physical characteristic of kurtosis that is not absolutely empirical. The availability of the proposed method is testified in a pilot plant producing polyethylene by gas-phase method, and the comparisons with the other time-domain characteristics of acoustic signal and with the other measurement variables show that the Gaussian detection of acoustic signal is more sensitive to agglomeration.

articleTitle: A mathematical expression of an index function in FRIT
abstract: FRIT(Fictitious Reference Iterative Tuning) is a model free designing method and a practically useful method. But in the method, there are some drawbacks, That is, the optimal controller's parameters are obtained to minimize a performance index. That is, for each set of parameter candidates, a response of the inverse system of the controller at every sampling time is required to be calculated. Hence, the drawbacks are (1) A large amount of calculation is required. (2) Since the method searches a minimal point of a performance index as the desired design parameters, the optimal point is unknown until the search ends to the optimal point. (3) Sometimes the design parameter values are changed from the optimal values according to practical reasons, as a result, how the index deteriorates is unknown. If a mathematical expression of the index function is obtained, then the index is calculated by just substituting the parameter values and these drawbacks will dissolve. Then this paper proposes a method to give the mathematical expression of the performance index. An example of designing a PID controller is given and the comparison of the necessary computing times of the original FRIT method and the proposed method is shown. Also simulation results are given.

articleTitle: Research on the profit model of the community service center respecting for sales and recycling
abstract: This paper mainly finds the optimal solutions of models and the price rules that community service center must follow, supposing that demanding function takes sales scope parameter and the government gives subsidies to the community service center. The first part of the paper establishes old market model and new market model with the new demanding function and gives the optimal solutions of them. The second part of the paper discusses the price rules that community service center must follow to ensure the profit of the old market when the government subsidize to the sales proceeding and the recycling proceeding respectively.

articleTitle: The design research of the indigenous steering gear
abstract: With the development of the robot industry, the requirements of the joint actuator are improved. The steering gear becomes the first choice of the joint actuator, which has the characteristics of a modular, high integration, Small volume. However, there are universal problems of the steering gear in the domestic market, that torque is too small and rotation angle range is only 120 degrees. This paper adopts the method of contrast analysis of the influence the steering performance of a series of parameters for optimization design of steering gear. Through the drive scheme design, structure design, precision analysis and engineering drawings to finish the design work. Harmonic reducer is used to realize the steering gear of high torque output function; The non contact magnetic encoder is chosen to detect the rotation angle and improve the positioning accuracy and expand the range of rotation angle; The three-loop control is used to improve the response speed and accuracy of the motor. This paper mainly introduces the present situation of domestic research and the design of each module, and gives the concrete scheme of mechanical structure, hardware circuit and software design.

articleTitle: On-line trajectory generation based on approximate analytical solutions
abstract: This paper presents an on-line trajectory generation method based on approximate analytical solutions. Based on a unified formula of inequality path constraints, a series of approximate analytical solutions considering the effects of Earth rotation and drag coefficient rate are derived. Further, the entry trajectory is divided into four phases and each phase is parameterized by one parameter, reducing the algorithm complexity. In addition, the path constraints can be satisfied by limiting the range of these parameters. Using the parameterized trajectory, the on-line trajectory generation problem is divided into two sub-problems: the longitudinal trajectory sub-problem and the lateral heading sub-problem. The longitudinal trajectory sub-problem is solved through sequentially searching the four parameters; the lateral heading sub-problem is accomplished through searching a bank reversal point with the help of the analytical solutions. And then, a trajectory generation algorithm is devised to meet the terminal design requirements of range to go and lateral heading. Simulation results of different orbital entry missions demonstrate that the proposed method is of satisfactory adaptability.

Author Keywords: Path constraints and Bank reversal point

articleTitle: Grid-plant coordination optimization scheduling for power-heat load with wind power integrated
abstract: Aiming at analyzing the effect of heat supply on power supply and wind curtailment, this paper constructs a new multi-area power-heat load scheduling model considering spinning reserve constraints of wind power and power-heat feasible region constraints of CHP (combined heat and power) units. Grid-plant coordination optimization scheduling method is proposed to solve this model. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme can effectively solve the multi-area power-heat dispatching problems as well as reflect operating characteristics of CHP units. Besides, the cause of wind curtailment during heating season is analyzed and the effect of heating plan on power supply capacity is quantitatively described.

articleTitle: Adaptive attitude controller design with bounded tracking error
abstract: Adaptive attitude tracking controller is designed for a spacecraft with constraints of uncertain perturbation of rotational inertia and bounded attitude tracking error. The compound disturbance combined with perturbation of rotational inertia and external environment is estimated by adaptive update law. An attitude tracking controller is designed for spacecraft based on barrier Lyapunov function. The controller can ensure the closed-loop system global asymptotical stability, and the attitude tracking errors are bounded in all time. Numerous simulation prove that the attitude controller have the advantage of high tracking precision, strong robustness and bounded tracking error.

articleTitle: Prediction and simulation of mooring ship motion based on intelligent algorithm
abstract: According to the security and early warning requirement of the mooring ship motion in a large open sea terminal, a prediction method has proposed. This prediction method based on the digital image which obtained from the camera. After image processing, the probabilistic neural network and the signature algorithm are used to identify the ship type, and then the corresponding historical data of this ship type in the database will be determined. The genetic algorithm and Levenberg Marquardt algorithm are used to predict the mooring ship motion. Simulation results show that the prediction method meet the actual demand.

articleTitle: Center-focus global contrast saliency detection
abstract: Saliency detection has a great significance in improving image analysis and processing techniques. In this paper, we propose a center-focus global contrast saliency detection method. First, we achieve the weight of focus-center feature map from frequency domain and get the salient center by weighted coordinates; Secondly we calculate the Euclidean distance between the image of each pixel and the saliency center for generating the focus-center feature map; Then the image is segmented by SLIC, and taking segments as a unit build the color global contrast feature map; Finally three feature maps are normalized and integrated as the saliency map. The saliency detection method proposed in this paper compare with 7 saliency detection methods by the public database Achtana1000 [12] and our method have higher precision and recall than others.

articleTitle: Non-fragile robust H∞ controller design for 4WS-4WD vehicle
abstract: Most of the methods about designing controllers introduced for four-wheel-steer (4WS) and four-wheel-drive (4WD) vehicles are derived with the assumption that the controller parameters are constant. However, in the running process of the actual system, because of word length, conversion accuracy, truncation error of numerical calculation and other factors, the parameters of controller are often fluctuant. The existing design methods of robust controller such as H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> and μ-synthesize are extremely sensitive to perturbations of controller parameters. Therefore, the robust non-fragile controller is designed in the condition that uncertainties of the system and the controller are all taken into consideration in order to solve above-mentioned problem by using linear matrix inequality (LMI).
