The results can be references of industrial policy, energy development and economic development measures for future development in Liaoning Province.

articleTitle: Point-to-point tracking of integrated predictive iterative learning control by using updating-reference and CARIMA model
abstract: For point-to-point tracking control problem of batch process, a novel design method based on Controlled Auto-regressive Integrated Moving Average (CARIMA) model and updating-reference is proposed in this paper. In the proposed approach, integrated predictive iterative learning control (IPILC) is used for the trajectory tracking control. Comparing with other point-to-point tracking control algorithms, the proposed control scheme performs better in robustness, and reduces the computation load which occurs in those algorithms based on the lifted model for non-Lyapunov-stable systems. Furthermore, updating-reference relaxes the constraints for system outputs and leads to faster convergence than the fixed-reference control algorithms. Simulation results on typical systems show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: Controlled Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average Model

articleTitle: Measurement on coordination between industrial structure and employment structure and its prediction in Henan province
abstract: Four methods: comparative labor productivity, employment elasticity, structure departure degree and coordination coefficient were respectively used to calculate the coordination between industrial structure and employment structure in Henan province. GM (1,1) model of recursive compensation by grey number of identical dimensions and a simple moving average method were used for the prediction. The results showed that: though the four methods calculated the coordination at different perspectives, they had coincident conclusion that there was plenty of surplus labor force in primary industry in Henan province and the employment structure was lagging behind the industrial structure. Finally, it had influenced on the coordination.

articleTitle: Harmony search resampling particle filter
abstract: Although particle filters have been widely applied from various fields, the impoverishment and degeneration of particle are important factors affecting the performance of particle filters. In this paper, harmony search was introduced into the particle resampling to enhance the algorithm. By updating the vector of harmony memory through the weight based multinomial resampling, the impoverishment and degeneration of particle was efficiently reduced. Experimental results showed that the harmony search resampling particle filters had more accurate filtering results than other typical filters such as system resampling filter.

articleTitle: A new criterion for echo state property of ESN with feedback
abstract: Echo state network (ESN) consists of input, output and reservoir which includes large and randomly connected neurons. For training network, only the connected weights from the reservoir to output units are learned. In this paper, based on the traditional criterions for echo state property of ESNs, a new criterion for echo state property with output feedback is proposed. For the training process of ESN, this criterion makes every training can ensure that the network has echo state property. Considering the output feedback, this can improve the degree of influence of the previous inputs and the current state, and reduce the vanished speed of the effect of the previous inputs and the current state. Through using analytical example, the effectiveness of this criterion is validated.

articleTitle: Mill sound detection based on signal singular entropy noise reduction
abstract: In the grinding process automatic control, detection and control of ball mill load is the important content of ball mill automatic control. Can detect the ball mill load accurately is a key to the success or failure of intelligent control of the whole ball. In the grinding sound signal measurements, the presence of the noise makes signal characteristics can not be extracted exactly, we cannot master the mill load conditions so that the ball mill cannot achieve automatic control. This article uses a kind of non-contact detection method to detect the ball mill load. Firstly, it uses a method based on singular entropy to proceed noise reduction processing of the measured grinding sound signal. Then extracts and analyzes the signal feature with FFT. Finally, we can obtain the conditions of the ball mill load. Simulation analysis shows that the method based on singular entropy can conduct the mill sound signal frequency domain identification accurately, in the existence of measurement noise. This method can help judge the ball mill load conditions, and it is suitable for different grinding system.

Author Keywords: the noise reduction based on singular entropy

articleTitle: Adaptive neural tracking control with prescribed performance for strict-feedback stochastic nonlinear systems
abstract: In this paper, the problem of prescribed performance adaptive neural tracking control design is investigated for strict-feedback stochastic nonlinear systems. The unknown nonlinear functions are tackled using the neural networks. Combining with prescribed performance function and backstepping technique, the desired adaptive controller is developed. It is proved that all the signals of the close-loop system are bounded in probability and the tracking error remains within a predefined arbitrarily small residual set with the prescribed performance bounds. Simulation results are provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Dynamic programming approach for multi-bandwidth offset optimization
abstract: Traditional optimization methods of arterial offset usually take the maximum of green-wave bandwidths, or the minimum of delays as control objective, which does not build an analytic relation between delay and green-wave bandwidth. In this paper, the arterial offset optimization method that can be applied to road network is proposed. At first, the calculation model of green-wave bandwidth is proposed by analyzing the pattern of vehicle queues; furthermore, green-wave bandwidth calculated by this model has a linear relation with the traffic delay in each intersection, and the maximum of number of vehicles passing intersections over bandwidth is regarded as the control objective solved by dynamic programming. For the coordination of the network, arterial definition in area is given and priority of arterial coordination is determined based on traffic load. At last, the proposed approaches are applied to a road network, which shows that the green-wave bandwidth is improved 24% compared with numerical solution approach, and the proposed approaches realize optimization of queuing delay and green-wave bandwidth at the same time.

articleTitle: Stability analysis for the lattice model considering the effects of bilateral gaps
abstract: This study proposes a new lattice model considering the effects of bilateral gaps on a road without lane discipline. In particular, a new lattice model is proposed to capture the impacts from the lateral gaps of the right-side and left-side sites of the considered lattice sites. Stability analysis of the proposed model is performed using the perturbation method to obtain the stability condition. Results from numerical experiment verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: The development of micro-source controller based on the model design method
abstract: There are many random micro-sources in the microgrid, which make it necessary to design complicated control strategies to ensure the safety and reliability of the system. In this paper a development process for a micro-source controller is presented. It is completely based on the model design method, which supports the rapid implementation of micro-source control strategies. The paper verifies V/f control strategy of micro-source in the island mode, by generating control codes automatically from Simulink model. The main development tools are based on the MATLAB2012 and CCS5.5. In the paper, the steps of how to make use of Simulink control model to generate DSP control codes are described in details. The experiment results verify the feasibility and validity of automatic code generation for micro-source controller based on the model design method, which shorten the development cycle greatly.

articleTitle: Mean square stabilization for stochastic switched fuzzy systems
abstract: In this paper, a mean square stabilization criterion for stochastic switched fuzzy (SSF) systems is proposed. SSF system, which differs from existing ones, can often incorporate discrete states, continuous dynamics and randomness as well as their interactions in complex real-world systems. In the beginning, switching parallel distributed compensation controller is introduced. The multiple Lyapunov function methods are adopted to establish the stability results. Moreover, sufficient conditions for mean square stability are presented and stabilizing switching laws of the state-dependent form are designed. Simultaneously, switching techniques are used to derive the criteria, some subsystems are allowed to be unstable. Finally, the elaborated illustrative example demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A decomposition based recursive least squares identification algorithm for input nonlinear systems
abstract: A decomposition based recursive least squares algorithm is derived for the identification of input nonlinear systems using the key term separation technique and the hierarchical identification principle. The proposed algorithm avoids estimating many crossed-parameters compared with the over-parameterization identification methods and requires less computational loads. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Identification of julia sets of complex standard family
abstract: Julia set is an important fractal set which has been applied extensively in many fields. Identification of Julia set of the complex standard family zn+1 = zn + α + β sin(z<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>) is discussed in this paper. Two controllers and parameter laws are designed to identify Julia set. It is shown that the design of the controllers and parameter laws achieve the identification of Julia sets with the unknown parameters. The simulations illustrate the efficacy of these methods.

articleTitle: Graph regularized compact self-representative decomposition for image representation
abstract: Matrix factorization techniques have been frequently applied in computer vision and pattern recognition. Among them, self-representative matrix decomposition which chooses original data matrix as the dictionary has received considerable attention in dimension reduction and data representation. In this paper, we propose a Graph regularized Compact Self-representative Decomposition (GCSD) method using the linear combination of original data as the dictionary and directly obtaining low dimensional representation of whole data. In GCSD, local geometrical structures are exploited by Laplacian graph, and the global structures are preserved by rank minimization. We develop the iterative updating optimization schemes for GCSD, and provided the convergence proof of our optimization scheme. Experiment results of USPS and COIL20 databases demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of a new fractional order piλ-PDμ Controller for Fractional Order System Based on BFGS Algorithm
abstract: A new fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>-PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller is proposed for fractional order plant in this paper, which is a six-parameter controller with special structure. The PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup> part and PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> part of the controller are separate placed in forward channel and internal feedback loop. The PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> feedback is used to change the poles of the plant transfer function to more desirable locations for control by a PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup> controller. With ITAE as the objective function, the six parameters of fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>-PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller could be obtained through BFGS optimization algorithm. Simulation results show that fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>-PD<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> controller has good anti - jamming performance, and can well restrain the overshoot of the fractional order system.

articleTitle: Output feedback control of discrete-time nonlinear quadratic systems with quantization effects and missing measurements
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of output feedback control for a class of discrete-time nonlinear quadratic systems with quantization effects and missing measurements. The measured output of system is quantized by a logarithmic quantizer. Moreover, the missing measurements are modeled by introducing a diagonal matrix composed of a series of mutually independent random variables satisfying certain probabilistic distributions on the interval [0 1]. In this paper, the output feedback controller design method, which guarantees the zero equilibrium point of the closed-loop system is stochastic stable, is provided. By using LMI technique, the sufficient condition is derived for computing the desired controller gain matrix and observer gain matrix of the system. Finally, a numerical example is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A robust pruning method for reduced weighted least squares support vector machine
abstract: In this paper, a robust pruning method for reduced weighted least squares support vector machine (RW-LSSVM) is proposed in order to improve the sparseness simultaneity concerning the robustness. By replacing the inequality constraints in SVM with equality constraints, LSSVM has a quite lower computation complexity meanwhile leading to a lack of robustness and sparseness. Several algorithms have been proposed to solve these problems but they usually focus on only one aspect. As always facing the situation that a well-performed sparse solution has an inferior generalization performance especially for datasets with high noises, the RW-LSSVM algorithm is considered as a proper way to robustly prune the support vectors to get a sparse solution with generalization considered as well. This algorithm set weights to the whole training set to ensure robustness and in each pruning step it uses the reduced LSSVM form to get a satisfactory sparseness by concerning the influence of all training samples on the sparse model where the model is composed only by a part of samples namely support vectors. To show the efficacy and feasibility of our proposed algorithm, some comparing experiments are carried out which are all favorable for our viewpoints.

articleTitle: Switched dynamic modelling and energy-based excitation control of multi-machine power systems
abstract: Excitation control is one of the most effective means to improve the dynamic performance of power systems. This paper investigate the switched excitation control of power systems with generator tripping operation under emergency. First, we discuss the dynamics of the generators under different operating conditions and put forward a switched power system model. Then, the switched dynamic model is transformed to its equivalent switched dissipative Hamiltonian system via a proper pre-feedback control, based on which an energy-based switched excitation controller is constructed. Using the Hamiltonian functions of the subsystems as multiple Lyapunov functions, the stability of the closed-loop system is analyzed. Simulation results show that the proposed switched excitation controller can effectively improve the transient stability of the power systems.

articleTitle: Farmland solid remote monitoring system based on embedded technology and BS mode
abstract: For the problems and deficiencies of the current farmland solid remote monitoring system, this paper introduces a kind of farmland solid remote monitoring system based on embedded technology and BS mode, the system achieves data acquisition and A / D converting, sending monitoring data to CDMA through serial port, converting the data to TCP/IP data packets, sending the data by using CDMA DTU, connecting to the remote web server, providing real-time data acquisition and remote transmission, also, the system realizes the monitoring data web management, the system is proved to be effective according to the result of running.

articleTitle: Time-varying Razumikhin and Krasovskii stability theorems for time-varying delay systems
abstract: The main results of the paper are generalizations of the Razumikhin and of the Krasovskii classical stability theorems for stability analysis of time-varying time-delay systems. The condition of negativity of the time-derivative of Razumikhin functions and Krasovskii functionals is weakened. This is achieved by using the notion and properties of uniformly stable scalar functions. We also show how to apply the results to the stability analysis of linear time-varying time-delay systems of retarded type. Both the system matrices and time-delays are allowed to be time-varying. Some constructive sufficient stability conditions are obtained and their effectiveness is demonstrated by an example.

articleTitle: How to improve the environmental quality of China from the perspective of fiscal policy?
abstract: Due to environmental pollution's overflow, this paper establishes spatial econometric models to do regression analysis, in which environmental protection expenditure is the explanatory variable and the emissions of industrial pollutants are the dependent variables. The results show that the environmental governance effects of China's fiscal policy are obvious. The best environmental governance model is industrial sulfur dioxide emission model, followed by the model of industrial solid waste emission. According to the empirical results, China should continue to emphasize the water environment governance and solid waste governance, when going on controlling the air pollution.

articleTitle: Based on principal component analysis odor character classification and application
abstract: This paper introduces the basic principle and calculation steps of the principal component analysis algorithm, and applies it to evaluate the quality of milk. Stored in different time of milk as an example: Using electronic nose to collect the volatile components of milk. The principal component analysis algorithm of electronic nose identification analysis software to classify different storage time of milk. Under the condition of Matlab, the principal component analysis algorithm is programmed. It is proved that the method of principal component analysis is effective in determining the quality of milk when the influencing factors are more, and the correlation between the factors is larger.

articleTitle: Application of alternating deep belief network in image classification
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the bottom layer parameters of deep belief network (DBN) can not be fully learned during the process of image classification, this paper proposes an image classification method based on alternating deep belief network (ADBN). After the unsupervised learning of each layer of restricted boltzmann machine (RBM), we use back propagation (BP) algorithm to fine tuning its parameters. Alternating the use of unsupervised and supervised training process, so that the entire network weights can achieve minimum training error. Consequently, a comparative experiment is conducted on multiple data sets of UCI database. Experimental results indicate that ADBN has effectively alleviated the problem of vanishing gradient and obtained higher accuracy than DBN and support vector machine (SVM).

articleTitle: Research on application of boost converter based on data-driven full-format model-free adaptive controller
abstract: During applications of DC-DC converters, it was found that the poor control accuracy is usually caused by the model mismatch which may come from the circuit parameters changes. In this paper we propose the method with data-driven model-free adaptive controller and applied it to the Boost converter. Comparing the data-driven model-free adaptive control with the PID control, The experimental result shows, the data-driven full-format model-free adaptive controller has more stable accuracy and is more capable of anti-interference, robustness and anti-mismatch.

articleTitle: Research on avionic component simulation model based on SCM
abstract: This paper proposes a normalized modeling method based on Simulation Component Model (SCM) for describing avionics in aircraft maintenance simulation process. The method can solve the problem of low reusability within the existing component models. The proposed avionic component model comprises an ontology, some interfaces and operation rules, which is built by the modeling specification and framework of SCM. The input and output signals of the model I/O interfaces are summed up according to the avionic component's characteristics and functions. A set of operation rules are defined between output signals and the other two signals, which are input signals and a return value from control functions. The model not only can realize the functional simulation, but also generate maintenance behaviors such as operation, test, removal, installation and troubleshooting. At last, the feasibility of this modeling method is verified on the self-researched aircraft maintenance simulator by taking the flight augmentation computer for example.

articleTitle: Finite-time parameter identification for a class of time-delay systems
abstract: This paper provides a new finite-time parameter identification method for linear time-delay(LTD) systems. The discussed algebraic technique, which is based on operational calculus, Leibniz formula, distribution theory, is non-asymptotic and can overcome the influence of the noise. The case with the unknown initial conditions can be treated thanks to the differential elimination method and good handling of the delay operator e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-τs</sup>. A general formula of the parameter identification in expression of the integrals of input and output variable is given, which allows all the calculation to be done rapidly by the computer. The effectiveness of the technique is demonstrated through examples and simulations.

articleTitle: Adaptive control and stability for characteristic model based on modified projected gradient estimators
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the tracking problem for a class of second-order time-varying characteristic model. An adaptive controller based on a modified projected gradient estimator is proposed. The closed-loop characteristic model is shown to be stable and, concurrently, an upper bound of the tracking error is given. Our results improve upon the findings of previous works by removing the sufficient fast sampling rate, and also lay certain theoretical foundations for practical applications of characteristic model-based adaptive control.

articleTitle: Switched control for nonlinear discrete singular systems and application
abstract: The problem of switched control investigated for a class of nonlinear discrete singular systems. A result for the stabilization of nonlinear discrete singular systems by a switched controller is derived. Switched controllers are designed for a class of nonlinear singular systems and a class of discrete singular bilinear systems. An invariant principle is presented for such switched nonlinear singular systems. The invariant principle and the switched controllers are used to globally stabilize a class of singular bilinear systems that are not open-loop stable. Numerical examples show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: A type of pole placement control method based on optical pointing mirror with pivot supporting
abstract: In view of the high precision optical mirror servo system, although the traditional state variable feedback control method can effectively revise the intrinsic mode of the mechanism with pivot supporting, it is difficult to implement in practice because of the difficulty of accurate observer design for high order state variable. In this paper, a controller design method based on pole placement is proposed. By means of adjusting the position of insignificant poles, the feedback gain of high order state variable in controller is weakened, which simplifies the process of high order state variable estimation and reduces the implementation difficulty without affecting the system dynamic performance. Simulation results are provided to prove the effectiveness and robustness of this method.

articleTitle: The study on dynamics of functional brain network: Based on symbolic dynamics
abstract: It is an important means to reveal mysteries of the brain with information theory, but scientists rarely use this method for the study of the nervous system in recent years. In this study, it's the first time, by using the concepts of information theory, to exploratory investigate the dynamic properties of time course data of fMRI and functional brain networks. Results show that the symbolic dynamics method can reduce the noise of the MRI datasets, and highlight the differences between the groups. In elderly group, the regions with larger entropy are mainly located in prefrontal regions, basal ganglia region. Meanwhile, there are significant differences in the search information entropy between the young and elderly groups. These results have significance for the interpretation of the brain mechanisms, which may be the basis for follow-up studies of the brain mechanisms.

articleTitle: Online adaptive monitoring for multiple operating batch processes
abstract: An adaptive monitoring method is proposed to detect the fault in complex batch processes with multiple operations. The method firstly starts with limited modeling data types to build the model, and then updates initial model data by collecting new normal batches. The specific process includes stage division, the conversion of non-Gaussian to Gaussian of process data and the construction of clustering model. Then, an adaptive updating algorithm, based on the selection of clustering models and up-down monitoring method, is developed for model updating to collect additional information from new normal batch data. The proposed method is illustrated through the 120t ladle furnace (LF) steelmaking process. Simulation results have shown the effectiveness of the proposed approaches compared to MPCA.

articleTitle: H∞ state estimation for T-S fuzzy neural networks with mixed time delays using secondary delay partitioning method
abstract: This paper adopts a secondary delay partitioning method to analyze the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> state estimation problem of T-S fuzzy neural networks with discrete and distributed delays. The delay interval is first divided into two parts, and each part is divided into several unequal subintervals. The two parts are connected by a term of the newly augmented Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional which is a double integral term with variable upper and lower limits of the integral. Using a new integral inequality which gives a sharper upper bound than Jensen's inequality and combining with extended reciprocal convex combination, novel delay-dependent criteria are obtained to guarantee that the zero solution of the error system is globally asymptotically stable with H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance index γ. A numerical example is used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Neural-based adaptive output-feedback control for a class of nonlinear systems
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of adaptive neural output-feedback control for a class of nonlinear strict-feedback systems. In this research, radial basis function (RBF) neural networks (NNs) are used to approximate the unknown nonlinear functions and a state observer is constructed to estimate the immeasurable state variables. An adaptive neural output feedback control scheme is proposed via backstepping technique. The proposed design method can guarantee semi-global uniform ultimate boundedness (SGUUB) of all signals in the closed-loop system, and ensures the observer errors converge to a small neighborhood. At last, a simulation example is included to show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An adaptive predictive controller based-on ARX-DIPLS model
abstract: An adaptivelpredictive control method based on ARX-DIPLS model is proposed to deal with the problem associates with model mismatch. The ARX-DIPLS modeling method makes use of the partial least squares to build the latent variable space, where an explicit dynamic inner model is given and kept consistent with the outer model at the same time. Therefore, collinearity between input and output can be eliminated and reliability of predictive model is guaranteed. Based on the inner model, an adaptive predictive controller with online updating of inner and outer model parameters is designed for achieving satisfactory control performance in the presence of plant-model mismatch. Simulating studies with the quadruple tank process verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of air hander sub system of HVAC
abstract: This paper is for the study of the control of air hander sub system of HVAC. Through establishing the model of cooling coil in air hander, under the condition of the outdoor air temperature changes, we use the method of optimal control to control the flow of chilled water. It can achieve the purpose of optimal control and save the energy. The results of Simulink show that: when the outdoor air temperature changes, in the request of different settings, through optimal control, the supply air temperature of HVAC can quickly track the set temperature.

articleTitle: Observer-based adaptive fuzzy control for nonlinear systems with unknown dead-zone input
abstract: This paper focuses on adaptive fuzzy output-feedback control for a class of single-input single-output(SISO) strict feedback systems with dead zone input. In this research, fuzzy logic systems are utilized to approximate the unknown nonlinear functions, and a state observer is constructed to estimate the unmeasurable state variables. Then adaptive fuzzy output feedback is developed via bacstepping recursive technology. The proposed control strategy guarantees that all the signals in the closed-loop system are semi-globally uniformly ultimately bounded (SUUB) by Lyapunov method and simulation results.

articleTitle: A fault-tolerant scheduling algorithm for distributed control system with possible hardware and software faults
abstract: Distributed control systems (DCSs) are one class of the most important distributed real-time systems which are widely applied in many fields. With the increase of the number of processors and the complexity, a DCS is subject to hardware and software failures. In this paper, we present a fault-tolerant scheduling algorithm which can tolerate both hardware faults and software faults. The backup copy of a task is executed only when its corresponding primary copy fails due to a fault. In order to decrease the number of preemptions and lower the runtime overhead of the algorithm, non-preemptive Earliest Deadline First (EDF) is applied to schedule primary copies which are assigned to the same processor, and the backward non-preemptive EDF is applied to schedule backup copies and to calculate notification times of tasks. Compared with BCE and DPA, simulation results show that NEFT can obtain a higher success rate in executing primary copies and lower the runtime overhead of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Inventory optimization for repairable spares with scrap during the mission
abstract: For the widely existed problem of the scrap of spares during the mission, an approximation method of inventory optimization for multi-indenture equipment is proposed. At first, the spares in lower indenture are totally converted to top indenture ones by omitting the maintenance time, so that multi-indenture spare is equivalent to single-indenture ones. Then the system availability is derived according to the additive property of Gamma distribution. Finally, the optimal inventory distribution result is obtained by marginal algorithm. In actual example, compared with simulation method, the approximation method is reasonable, feasible, and easy to implement, and can meet to support demands in most occasions except the maintenance time is too long.

articleTitle: The research of performance test method of urban rail train safety detection sensor network
abstract: The paper designs a performance test method which is based on the international network test theory and the actual operation of urban rail train safety detection sensor network. With the establishment of the benchmark testing system that takes transmission delay, packet loss rate, throughput and back to back as indexes and the overall network performance test evaluation model, the performance test method proposed by the article can be used to evaluate a network that has identified network topology and protocols, and choose rational network topology and protocols when designing a network.

Author Keywords: Urban rail train safety detection sensor network

articleTitle: A Traffic signs' detection method of contour approximation based on concave removal
abstract: In this paper, a simple and efficient algorithm for detecting deformed and occlusion triangular and circular traffic signs under complex natural scenes is proposed. Firstly, the image is segmented and binarized. Then the convex hull of every contour extracted from the binarized image is calculated. Some concave part of a contour is removed and is replaced by the corresponding convex edge of the convex hull. After that, the contour is approximated to a polygon. Finally, Those contours which can be succeed to approximated to a triangle is the triangular traffic signs, and other contours approximation which can be approximated to a ellipse with random least squares fitting is the circular traffic signs. The experimental results shows the detection rate reaches 86.79%, this algorithm can handle the adverse influence of traffic signs' deformation, occlusion better than hough method. It has better real-time performance and lower error detection rate than template method.

articleTitle: The choice of manufacturer's online customization channel under different pricing models
abstract: To explore the market conditions of adding online customization channel under different pricing models, this paper constructs a two-stage supply chain model composed of one manufacturer and one retailer. We obtain some key findings. Firstly, the manufacturer has a stronger incentive to provide customized products in the decentralized scenario than in the centralized one; and discriminatory pricing is more favorable than uniform pricing for the manufacturer. Secondly, adding online customization channel raises wholesale price and retail price and leads to the existence of a Pareto improvement zone. Finally, under discriminatory pricing model, the manufacturer offers a higher customization level and higher wholesale price; and the profit of the manufacturer is higher while the retailer's is lower.

articleTitle: The modelling and control of a singular biological economic system with a species migration and environment damage
abstract: The paper deals with singular biological economic model of species population and environment at permanent area, meanwhile presenting stage structure. Firstly, the ecosystem of the area is represented by a set of nonlinear differential equations involving migration and environment. Then, we analyze the local stability of equilibriums of the system when the economic profit parameter is zero. By applying the singular systems theory and bifurcation theory, it is shown that the conditions of the singularity induced bifurcation under the positive equilibrium. In order to eliminate the singularity induced bifurcation, we design a state-feedback controller by controlling the strength of environmental protection. At last, We are numerically simulating to support the results of the analysis.

articleTitle: Extended dissipative analysis of delayed stochastic Markovian jump neural networks
abstract: In this brief, an extended dissipativity analysis is developed for a delayed stochastic Markovian jump neural networks(DSMNNs). Based on the concept of the extended dissipative, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub>, L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub>, the passive and dissipative performance are solved by adjusting the weighting matrices in a new performance index. In addition, two different methods are applied to deal with the stochastic cross terms containing Ito integral.

Author Keywords: Delayed stochastic Markovian jump neural networks

articleTitle: Stability analysis for delayed recurrent neural networks based on delay-decomposition approach
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of asymptotic stability of recurrent neural networks with time-varying delays. The activation functions are monotone nondecreasing with known lower and upper bounds, and satisfy a more general sector condition. A novel Lyapunov-Krasovsii functional based on delay-decomposition approach is constructed. By using Jensen inequality and reciprocally convex combination to estimate the derivative of Lyapunov-Krasovsii functional, a new stability criterion for recurrent neural networks with time-varying delays is obtained. And a numerical simulation is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Observer-based controller synthesis for T-S fuzzy systems under imperfect premise matching
abstract: This study focuses on observer-based controller synthesis for T-S fuzzy systems under imperfect premise matching. The fuzzy observer and fuzzy controller do not share the same membership functions and rules number with the T-S fuzzy systems. That is to say, the membership functions and rules number of the fuzzy observer and fuzzy controller can be chosen freely, which can enhance robustness and flexibility. Using Lyapunov stability theory and some inequality techniques, the existence conditions of the fuzzy observer and fuzzy controller are formulated in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). A numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Traffic image denoising research based on wavelet transform
abstract: For a variety of interference exists in the collected real-time traffic images at the scene, and affects the traffic images of authenticity, we de-noise the traffic images with wavelet threshold. In order to verify the effect of de-noising, we add noise to the images, and then de-noise them in the method by hard threshold. The simulation experiments show that the de-noising effect is obvious and can meet the design requirements. Then de-noise the collected traffic images by suitable determine the decomposition levels and appropriate threshold, and do the inverse wavelet transform, we can obtain the much clearer de-noised traffic image.

articleTitle: Adaptive cascade generalized predictive control
abstract: Cascade control is one of the most popular structures for process control as it is a special architecture for dealing with disturbances. However, the drawback of cascade control are obvious that primary controller and secondary controller should be tuned together, which influences each other. In this paper, a new Adaptive Cascade Generalized Predictive Controller (ACGPC) is introduced. ACGPC is a method issued from GPC and the inner and outer controllers of a cascade system are replaced by one cascade generalized predictive controller, which the both loops model are updated by Recursive Least Squares method. Compared with existing methods, the new method is simpler and yet more effective. It can be directly integrated into commercially available industrial auto-tuning systems. Some examples are given to illustrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Stability analysis and stabilization for quadratic discrete-time systems with actuator saturation
abstract: In this paper, we deal with the stability and stabilization problems for quadratic discrete-time systems with input saturation. By introducing an auxiliary matrix and a particular representation for the quadratic terms, sufficient conditions for stability and stabilization for quadratic discrete-time systems are derived in terms of “quasi”-linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Then, LMIs-based optimization problems are presented to maximize the region of attraction of corresponding systems. Simulation examples are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Adaptive fault detection for uncertain linear discrete-time system based on zonotope
abstract: This paper design a double interval adaptive observer to solve the problem of fault detection for linear discrete-time uncertain system. The first observer is a general observer, the residuals are obtained by observer state; The second observer is an interval observer with disturbance and uncertain parameter to calculate the threshold of residual, avoid false detection. The threshold of residual is calculated by zonotope algorithm, this method does not need to know the value of uncertain parameters and disturbances, only need to know its boundary. Then the size and location of fault are calculated using adaptive algorithm.

articleTitle: A trajectory tracking control strategy for a novel multi-rotor aircraft
abstract: Aiming at the existing inadequacies ofthe current multi-rotor aircraft, a novel multi-rotor aircraft which has new and unique layout, simple structure, hardware redundancy is presented. Also this aircraft is practically easy to be accomplished. A trajectory tracking control scheme is also proposed in this paper for the multi-rotor aircraft. Firstly, the kinematics and dynamics models of the aircraft are described. Then, attitude controller based on backstepping is designed. In order to improve the system's rapid response to the commands, a command filter and a linear tracking differentiator are employed in the controller design procedure of the dynamics model. At the same time, a position controller based on PD is also designed for calculating the attitude angle information to track the desired trajectory. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm for trajectory tracking scheme is verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Complex network's topological similarity analysis based on spectral density
abstract: Spectral density of complex network can reflect network's structural properties. After the comparison of WS `small-world' networks, ER random networks, BA `scale-free' networks and CNN networks with different parameters and scales, the shapes of spectral density curves perform very strong clustering features. Based on these results, this paper proposes a novel method analyzing the similarity of network topology based on the shapes of spectral density curves. The specific definition and algorithm of similarity indices are also given. The topological similarity among model networks, real networks and their subnets is analyzed by the proposed method. Experiments results on both model networks and real networks verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dynamic stabilization of a one-dimensional wave equation with variable coefficient under delayed observation
abstract: This paper is concerned with stabilization of a one-dimensional wave equation with variable coefficient, which suffers from an arbitrary time delay in the observation. We commit ourselves to the wave equation with variable coefficients generalized of that with constant coefficients under delayed observation. The observer and predictor systems are constructed to introduce the estimated state feedback controller. By the approach of Riesz basis property, it is shown that the closed-loop system is stabilized exponentially. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effect of the stable controller.

articleTitle: Analyses for optimal control of discrete time-delay systems based on ADP algorithm with finite-horizon performance index
abstract: An optimal control scheme is obtained for a class of nonlinear discrete time-delay systems in this paper. Based on adaptive finite-horizon dynamic programming (ADP) algorithm, we focus on two different initial control conditions, and then the value iteration method is used to get the iterative performance index function and iterative control. Two neural networks, which are named as critic network and action network are used to approximate the performance index function and compute the optimal control policy. The iteration termination error and the performance index function are analyzed based on different initial states. In the simulation study, we analysis the control results of different initial states and different maximal iterative steps.

articleTitle: Cluster synchronization of linearly coupled complex networks with nonidentical nodes via event-triggered strategy
abstract: In this paper, the cluster synchronization problem for complex networks with linearly coupled nonidentical dynamical systems is concerned by using event-triggered strategy, that is, the event-triggered rules are applied to the coupling terms of the complex networks. Some simple yet generic criteria of cluster synchronization in continuous monitoring event-triggered rules are obtained by means of the Lyapunov function, the algebraic graph, and the differential inequality method. In addition, the inter-event intervals of all nodes under some restrictions are proved to be strictly positive, which indicates that there is no Zeno behavior under our schemes. Finally, several numerical examples are presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Suboptimal guidance law design for ground target localization and tracking
abstract: This paper considers trajectory optimization for missiles to enhance the capability to estimate target locations during the attack phase. Using a cost function based on the determinant of the Fisher information matrix, a suboptimal guidance law which satisfies the field of view constraint and dynamics constraints is designed with single step method. The guidance law has a simple structure and can generate the guidance command online. At last, simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of sewage treatment system based on ARM controller
abstract: In this paper, the oily sewage treatment using the technology of ceramic membrane filtration is described. The intelligent control system of distributed sewage treatment is designed. Using multiple ARM processor STM32F103VET6 for each module processing chip, point to point signal transmission through RS232, The operation parameters of each module and its operation status are set up by using several industrial touch screen, and industrial control computer is used to monitor the system status of the whole control system, and set the system running parameters, the industrial control touch screen and industrial control computer communicate through the industrial Ethernet. Based on Visual Basic software, the application program of the host computer is designed for the sewage treatment system. At last, field operation experiment of control system is carried out, the experimental results show that the system can meet the requirements of wastewater treatment control, and the reliability is high, and the operation is stable.

articleTitle: The research on optimized control strategy of horseshoe flame glass furnace flaming system
abstract: This article discusses to use the search for self-optimizing stepping control algorithm, by adjusting the ratio of the secondary air flow and the heavy oil flow, and then automatically searching the secondary air to make it work in the vicinity of the ratio and achieve optimized control of the burning system.

articleTitle: Particle detection on low contrast image of large aperture optics
abstract: It's a challenge to identify actual deposited particles from the acquired optics image mixed with large noises. Due to the long working distance constraint for online inspecting large aperture optics, the vision system has great depth of view. It results in that the acquired optics image is blended with stain contamination on the back side of the inspected optics surface. In this paper, we propose a particle detection method for the low contrast image of large aperture optics. The method consists of three steps including particle candidate detection, image alignment and particle determination. The particle candidate detection algorithm combines the gradient information to detect small particles. The actual particles are determined by the subtraction of the reference image from the inspected image with the topological information. For the detected particle, this paper also gives a classification method to identify dust and defect. Experiment shows that the actual particle on the low contract image of large aperture optics can be effectively detected and classified with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Two tracking control method to improve solar cell photoelectric efficiency
abstract: The surface of solar cell panels in outdoors was easy to be covered a lot of dust so the photoelectric conversion efficiency would decrease. The stubborn dusts even damage the device. In this paper, Nano-diamond coating film was prepared the surface of solar cell. Solar cell panels were usually fixed installation. However, the position of the sun was changing from east to west constantly in one day. The system could not make full use of solar energy, which resulted in lower power generation. A dual-axis automatic solar tracking system combine photoelectric tracking was used in different time. Through experiments simulation and data analysis, Nano-diamod coating film combine above automatic tracking to Improve the photoelectric Conversion Efficiency of Solar Cell Panel, and the dual-axis automatic tracking method was simple and lower cost.

articleTitle: A new method for general work piece recognition based on Neural Network
abstract: In this paper, a new method for general work piece recognition based on Wavelet Neural Network is proposed. The composition of the experimental system is introduced and the operating principle is analyzed. The invariant moment is a highly concentrated image feature, which have the characteristics of invariant to translation and rotation. In the selection of the classifier, the Wavelet Neural Network is adopted in that this method has the great advantage of fast training speed and high recognition rate relative to BP Neural Network. Ada-boost is employed because no matter which kind of neural network is used, we can use it to improve the recognition accuracy of the neural network. This is a very wide range of network performance improvement method. The experimental results illustrate that the image recognition method based on “wavelet neural network + ada-boost” has better ability of classification.

articleTitle: Impulse analysis for nonlinear singular system via Differential Mean Value Theorem
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the impulse effect in nonlinear singular system, since the existence of the nonlinear dynamics, we use the Differential Mean Value Theorem based method to transfer the nonlinear singular system into a linear parameter varying system. It should be noted that Differential Mean Value Theorem is an identical transmission, thus, for the nonlinear system, if we transfer the nonlinear system into a linear system via differential mean value theorem, the properties of the original system will not be changed. Based on this point, we try to analyze the transferred singular system by some existence method which applied to the linear singular system.

Author Keywords: Impulse Analysis and Differential Mean Value Theorem

articleTitle: Fault tolerant control design for the attitude control systems of flexible spacecraft with sensor faults
abstract: This paper presents a fault compensation-based fault tolerant control scheme for the attitude control systems of flexible spacecraft with sensor faults using descriptor observer technique. Firstly, the flexible spacecraft attitude dynamics model is introduced, and a healthy dynamic output feedback controller is also given. When some unknown sensor faults occurred, to achieve the estimation value of unknown faults, the faulty attitude control systems of flexible spacecraft are transformed into the augment descriptor systems, and then a descriptor observer is developed to obtain the accurate estimation value of sensor faults. Based on Lyapunov approach, the descriptor observer unknown gain matrix is characterized in terms of the solution to a linear matrix inequality, which can be readily solved using standard software packages. Next, the compensation-scheme-based fault tolerant controller is presented for the faulty attitude control systems of flexible spacecraft by using the obtained the sensor fault estimation information. Finally, simulation results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Analysis and design for discrete-time singular systems with time-delay and actuator saturation by a saturation-dependent Lyapunov function
abstract: In this paper, the control problem for discrete-time singular time-delay systems with actuator saturation is considered. Firstly, a sufficient delay-dependent condition, under which such type discrete-time singular system with actuator saturation is regular, causal, and stable, is proposed by a saturation-dependent Lyapunov function. Then, based on the derived condition, the design method of controller is developed by using linear matrix inequalities (LMI) optimization problem without any decompositions of system matrices and equivalent transformation. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Wind turbine performance monitoring based on nonlinear state estimate technique
abstract: The growing wind turbines aging problem leads to high maintenance costs and low economy benefit It is crucial to monitor the wind turbine performance in real time. This paper uses the utilization rate of wind energy to represent wind turbine performance which comprehensively indicates changes of multiple factors. Firstly, several crucial factors including turbulence intensity, tip speed ratio, yaw and so on which influence utilization rate of wind energy are extracted from Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system. Then model of the power coefficient is built using nonlinear state estimate technique (NSET). The model reflects the relationship of the utilization rate of wind energy and other influence factors when wind turbines operate normally. After the establishment of the model, the real time SCADA data provides the input vector and an output vector will be estimated with the NSET model. If the input vector is abnormal, the predicted residual will increase observably, which indicates the wind turbine has failure. Several experiments are conducted and the method works quite promising.

Author Keywords: The utilization rate of wind energy

articleTitle: Research on LDPC code decoding algorithm based on scheduling strategy
abstract: With the rapid development of the channel coding technology, low density parity check(LDPC) code has been widely concerned by researchers all of the world as an approaching code to Shannon limit. Error floor is an important issue in the theory of LDPC codes and the research of iterative decoding algorithms. Based on the decoding of LDPC codes, a new improved decoding algorithm, Group Belief Propagation (GBP) based on variable nodes is proposed for the different scheduling strategies of the LDPC codes. According to the difference between the messages and the hard decision values, the variable nodes are divided into reliable nodes and unreliable nodes. And the unreliable nodes are priority to update. Further, the effect of threshold for judging the group on GBP strategy is analyzed. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve better convergence and decoding performances compared to three classical scheduling algorithms. Meanwhile, it can overcome the error floor phenomenon caused by the trapping set effectively.

articleTitle: Research on BP neutral network based grid-connected photovoltaic inverter
abstract: In this document, a BP neural network based PID control is designed considering the characteristics of solar power generation based on profound research on BP neural network control technique. In addition, computerized control program has been developed for grid-connected photovoltaic inverters for power generation, which has been applied for current control of grid-connected inverters. Digital simulation tests indicate such controller can effectively improve waveform of grid-connection current and dynamic process of grid-connection control of photovoltaic system by dynamically changing the parameters of PID controller. In addition, it realizes same frequency and same phase for both output current of inverter and voltage of gird while improving immunity. In the end, smooth grid connection is realized for photovoltaic generation system.

articleTitle: An intelligent heating energy-saving system based on CAN-bus
abstract: Energy-saving and pollution reduction is of great social significance. In this system CAN-bus technology is used for its characteristics of flexibility, reliability, real-time, longer transmission distance than that of the 485 bus. Module K7110 is used to convert RS232 and CAN data connected to the CAN-bus. Thermocouple input module K8510 connected with a temperature sensor are used to collect temperature data. Relay output module K8518 and electric valve which is installed on every inlet pipe of radiator are used to control the heat flow according to the commands from the system. The software can accept user's setting for room mode according to the time it used. This system realizes intelligent control for a single room based on CAN-bus and gets the maximum energy-saving. It is proved that it can save heat more than 35% by comparing more similar rooms through two heating period. It has the promotion value in heating system of existing public building in North China.

articleTitle: Research on force assignment for ground-to-air radar jamming system based on improved chaos genetic algorithms
abstract: In the battle of anti-air attack, the troops have to carry out the electronic jamming by integrated using of electronic measures in order to weaken the airborne Radar detection ability for the enemy. The allocation of jamming arms plays important role in influencing the jamming benefit directly. In this paper, we propose an arms allocation model for Radar jamming system based on the chaos genetic algorithms by thinking of the characteristic of anti-air battle. By loading the chaos variable to the variable group of Genetic Algorithms and laying a tiny disturbance using the chaos variable on the filial generation group and adjusting the jamming arguments when evolving the searching, we enhance the partial searching ability for the new algorithm, moreover, making the algorithm global optimality. Simulation shows the algorithm can solve the complex and difficult problem for the arms allocation with Radar jamming system effectively.

articleTitle: Research on WeChat marketing path of enhancing customer marketing experiences
abstract: With the increasing popularity of WeChat, WeChat marketing becomes a new Popular tool to the enterprises and merchants. They want to use WeChat to get the attention and recognition of the user, and closer the relationship between the gap with the user. After the analysis of consumers purchase motivation and behavior patterns in WeChat marketing, it researched WeChat marketing paths to enhance the customer experience and Put forward effective WeChat marketing strategy of improving customer experience to Make WeChat marketing real utility.

articleTitle: Stabilization of continuous-time switched positive systems with state constraints via a mode-dependent switching method
abstract: In this paper, we deal with the stabilization problem for a class of continuous-time switched positive systems with state constraints based on mode-dependent average dwell time(MDADT). An improved average dwell time method is presented, which considers different decay rates of a Lyapunov function related to each of the active subsystems according to the saturations occur or not, respectively. The stabilizing state feedback controllers for stabilization of continuous-time switched positive systems with state constraints based on MDADT are derived. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed approach are illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Micro-vibration control method based on magnetic flux notch filter for magnetically levitated rotor
abstract: In this paper, a novel active vibration control method based on flux feedback is proposed. In which, hall sensor is used to detect the flux of magnetic bearings. Three micro-vibration control methods of position-loop notch filter, magnetic force estimation notch filter and magnetic flux notch filter are analyzed and simulated in detail. The simulation results show that the magnetic flux feedback eliminates the measurement error of air gap, the magnetic force non-linearity and the current/displacement stiffness error caused by the error of the vibration estimation. The system vibration is reduced by 89% on the basis of the magnetic force estimation notch filter.

articleTitle: Optimal power distribution method for microgrids integrated system
abstract: Microgrid containing Wind Power(PV) and Photovoltaic(PV) has been an access and management structure of renewable energy. Part of microgrids are not isolate and can be integrated into external grid. How to make the entire system running more economically, saving operating costs and fuel costs? It's an really issue to optimal dispatching the devices power in the microgrid and the external grid. On a series analysis, the economical dispatching and optimal power flow calculation method based on equal incremental rate non-renewable fuels consumption theory was introduced.

articleTitle: Attribute reduction for Chinese question classification
abstract: With the rapid development of the question and answer services based on community, like Sina Ask, Baidu Zhidao and Yahoo! The Community-based Question Answering service has been became a new knowledge-sharing model with characteristics of interactivity and openness. The community sites provide high quality service to meet clients' need and attract them actively participation. In order to accurately understand the user query and provide useful information, it is necessary to deal with the questions in the community. Additionally, question classification in the CQA is the key component in this step. As everyone knows, the difficulty of the question classification is High-dimensional feature vector, usually uses feature selection as the primary method of dimensionality reduction, The author adopts the following way in this paper: Firstly, we usually use feature selection to screen out first feature subset, then use the dependence of the rough set as a heuristic information to deeply feature selection, last, screen out more useful features in the experiment. The experiment data suggests that the algorithm is effective, it can not only reduce the dimension of questions, but also improve the classification accuracy effectively.

articleTitle: Rough fuzzy set based on logical disjunct operation of variable precision and grade in ordered information system
abstract: Combining the respective advantages of relative and absolute quantitative information, this paper proposes the model of the rough fuzzy set, which is based on logical disjunct operation of variable precision and grade in ordered information system Moreover, the basic structure and precise description of rough set regions of the model are studied, and some important properties of the model are investigated carefully. Further, the significance of this study is interpreted by combining the analysis of an illustrative case study about the medical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Robust speed control of a permanent magnet synchronous motor system
abstract: In this paper, a sliding mode controller (SMC) and a linear active disturbance rejection controller (LADRC) are applied to a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) respectively for speed control. PMSM is a major part of electric drive systems. It has its inherent problems of nonlinearity, coupling, and structured uncertainties, and is subject to external load disturbance. Both LADRC and SMC can successfully drive the speed output of a PMSM to a reference signal despite the presences of uncertain dynamics and unknown disturbance. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and robustness of the LADRC and SMC. The speed control performances of both controllers are compared with each other. The comparison study shows that the SMC is superior to LADRC in being robust against parameter variations while the LADRC is better than SMC in disturbance rejection.

articleTitle: Adaptive Jacobian coordinated manipulation for multiple robot manipulators
abstract: In this paper we propose an adaptive Jacobian coordinated control method for cooperative robot manipulators, considering that the kinematics and dynamics of the robot manipulators are uncertain. By exploiting the property that the velocity and dynamics are linear in a set of physical parameters, an adaptive Jacobian coordinated control method is designed based on position/force hybrid control method. The system stability is proved by using Lyapunov method, and simultaneously the effectiveness is demonstrated in a circle trajectory tracking simulation.

articleTitle: A closed-loop PD-type iterative learning algorithm for discrete singular systems
abstract: Based on a dynamic decomposition standard form of discrete singular systems, we propose a closed-loop PD-type iterative learning control algorithm to study the problem of the state tracking in this paper. Furthermore, we put forward the convergence conditions of the algorithm and prove the convergence of the algorithm theoretically. The effectiveness of the closed-loop PD-type iterative learning control algorithm is proved by the illustrative example.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of full form dynamic linearization controller based data-driven model free adaptive control
abstract: Full form dynamic linearization controller based data-driven model free adaptive control algorithm has been studied in control community. This method merely requires the I/O data of the plant to design the controller and is easy for implementation. However, there still lacks necessary research on the conditions which can guarantee the stability of the closed loop system. This paper presents a stability analysis result for a class of nonlinear system. With some mild assumptions, the convergence of the output regulating error was derived by rigorous mathematical method, which guarantees the correctness of the proposed method in theory.

articleTitle: Nonlinear fermentation process fault monitoring based on JITL strategy
abstract: PCA, as the representative of the traditional global fault monitoring algorithm, is a linear feature extraction algorithm. So global algorithm may cause a lot of false alarms in fault monitoring of fermentation process with nonlinear and multi-stage characteristics. In this paper, the Just In Time Learning (JITL) strategy is introduced into the Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) algorithm. The local model is established with the data similar to the current online sample. Because the local model can represent the current state of the system, it is not necessary to identify the stages before monitoring. At the same time, the local KPCA model can be used to feature extract nonlinear data. The data generated by the PenSimv2.0 simulation platform is used for verifying the algorithm. The results show that this method has a better effect than KPCA algorithms.

articleTitle: A study on the capacity of shunt hybrid active power filter
abstract: To implement the application of APF in high voltage system with a limited capacity, improved strategies are proposed in this paper. FSRC is the new circuit structure that the APF connected to the grid which effectively reduces the voltage of APF; At the same time, the proposed frequency dividing detection method can effectively reduce the calculation current in capacity. After the theoretical analysis, on the basis of meeting the requirements of harmonic suppression, these strategies can effectively improve the application of smaller capacity APF in high voltage systems, and the fast and efficient control measures is another tend to realize the improved application.

articleTitle: Multi-temporal image registration utilizing a differential evolution algorithm with replacement strategy
abstract: Image registration is effect by finding the best spatial transformation between the reference image and the floating image in terms of optimizing a similarity metric. Mutual information, as an effective method, is a reliable criterion for image registration. In this paper, we propose an improved differential evolution algorithm with replacement strategy to maximize the mutual information for multi-temporal image registration. Experimental results show that our new algorithm achieves more precise and robust results when compared with several other classical optimization methods.

articleTitle: State tracking of nonlinear system with multiplicative noises based on AR-SIS particle filter
abstract: Under the framework of Bayesian filter, a sequential importance sampling particle filter based on the acceptance-rejection (AR) sampling is proposed for tracking the state of a nonlinear dynamic system. A set of samples is sequentially drawn to represent the posterior distribution of the state with the new observation at current time. In the existing filtering methods, the new observation is used only in the updating stage, not in the prediction stage. Our sampling method differs from the existing ones in that at the prediction stage the new observation is also used in order to evaluate the new weights of the samples. For illustration, the proposed particle filter is used to track the state of a nonlinear system with the multiplicative noise, which occurs in the measurement equation.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of schedule and route in container supply chain
abstract: As supply chain become more and more global and more operations are being outsourced and moved offshore, the impact of transportation on supply chain performance is increasing. Containerized ocean transportation has become the lifeline of almost any global supply chain. In the global container supply chain transit time become one of the dominating factors for shippers to choose ocean liner carriers. As a result, carriers who can take the cargo to the destination on time will win in the competition. So, this paper analysis hos ship scheduling and route design affect the transit time and considering the constraint of transit time make model in order to jointly deploy the shipping speed and designing ship route. And then we put the model in use with a case. First we find the optimal speed and route for the carrier. Then we analysis from four aspects: speed, port time, maximum transit time and inventory routing. Finally we develop two diffident models considering the maximum transit time and the uncertainty port time.

articleTitle: A predict method of probability of packet loss based on regression analysis
abstract: In order to guarantee the control performance of system, networked control system requires the information arrived in time. As the incident which influences the timeliness of information delivery in the system, packet loss should be predicted and take steps in advance. The paper counts the packet in the system transmission to found out the relationship between the probability of packet loss and the other parameters through regression analysis. The data was showed and simulated by Matlab.

articleTitle: Fuzzy PID control of disk-shaped magnetic suspended rotor system subject to lateral base motion
abstract: Recently, more and more AMB (active magnetic bearing) have been applied in automobile, airplane and submarine, where the base motion can not be ignored. Under these conditions, the dynamic model which considered the stiffness of the base as infinity is inaccuracy because of the large influence of the base motion. To investigate the dynamic characteristic of disk-shaped magnetic suspended rotor active magnetic bearing-rotor system which is subjected to lateral base motion. The mathematical model of the base, magnetic bearing and disk-shaped rotor is developed in this paper. Fuzzy PID controller was adopted in the disk-shaped magnetic suspended rotor system. The effects of base motion, electrical differential equations of control system and the mounting of sensors at different positions on the dynamic characteristics of the disk-shaped magnetic suspended rotor system were discussed. The result showed the effect on magnetic bearing under the influence of lateral base motion should be considered in control system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of intelligent gateway for smart home
abstract: With the gradual development of Internet of Things (IOT), there is a growing demand for intelligent household products in Smart Home. The access to a network through traditional technologies like IPv4, Bluetooth and ZigBee can no longer meet the requirements of Smart Home. In this paper, the Smart Home network based on the next generation of network protocol IPv6 is designed, and an IPv6-based Smart Home intelligent gateway system is implemented. Thus, the intelligent household products can be directly connected to the Internet, which will bring an unprecedented experience to the users. Major technical points are illustrated in the process of constructing Smart Home network, including the design of the intelligent gateway control system for Smart Home.

articleTitle: Prediction of the laws of carbon steel erosion corrosion in sour water system based on decision tree and two kinds of artificial neural network model
abstract: To explore the corrosion induced failure problem of carbon steels commonly existed in sour water system, first, erosion failure database is built on the basis of self-built rotary erosion experimental device. Furthermore, a decision tree based erosion level prediction model is proposed. At the same time, by means of two kinds of neural network, erosion rate prediction model is also proposed based on carbon steel erosion experimental samples: first, self-organization mapping (SOM) network is firstly applied to obtain the relevant relationship between variables by the explorative clustering analysis of multivariate samples. Then error back propagation (BP) neural network is adopted to model and predict corrosion rate of carbon steel samples. The test results show that the prediction accuracy of the decision tree model can be 100% and the average error the BP neural network model applied in this paper can be as low as 3.63%, which provides a new method for material selection and real time corrosion prediction and control in petrochemical system.

articleTitle: Robust stabilization of uncertain descriptor fractional-order systems with the fractional order α (0 < α < 1)
abstract: In the paper, a necessary and sufficient condition for uncertain descriptor fractional-order systems is given. The result is given in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMI). The uncertainties are supposed to be time-invariant and norm-bounded appearing in the state matrix. Robust stability of the state feedback control for uncertain descriptor fractional-order systems with the fractional order α (0 <; α <; 1) is derived. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the applicability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The battleplane target detection based on sky background
abstract: Battleplane is a kind of important strategic target in the military field, the research of using the infrared electric equipment to detect battleplane target is a hotspot in today's world. In view of this research background, we propose a method of battleplane target detection based on sky background. First, the infrared image of battleplane is preprocessed and collected by infrared electric equipment, and then we use the image enhancement technology on the preprocessed image according to the multi-scale fractal feature MFFK. Finally, we propose a method of graph cut segmentation to segment the enhanced image and the combination of prior knowledge to achieve battleplane target detection. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the detection method, improve the real-time performance and the applicability of battleplane target detection.

articleTitle: Network-based synchronization via fuzzy variable structure control with stochastic actuator activation and its application to secure communication
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of network-based synchronization via fuzzy variable structure control, where network-induced delay and stochastic actuator assignment are taken into account.
